name: Guest registration and tourist-tax sync for private room renters
text: - **Guest registration and tourist-tax sync for private room renters**: killed by AJPES eTurizem. A single daily submission reaches the police, municipalities, tourist boards and the statistics office, and eTurizem takes XML imports and a web service that PMS and channel managers already use. Sources: https://www.pzs.si/javno/gk/Zbor_gospodarjev/2018/Register%20nastanitvenih%20obratov%20in%20poro%C4%8Danje.pdf, https://www.soca-valley.com/sl/poslovne-strani/turisticna-taksa-in-prijava-gostov/

name: Waste evidence-list (evidenčni list) automation
text: - **Waste evidence-list (evidenčni list) automation**: killed by the state system ARSO IS-Odpadki. It supports e-signing, collectors completing lists for senders under authorisation, and XML import from local systems, and collectors already run their own software. Sources: https://www.gov.si/assets/organi-v-sestavi/ARSO/Odpadki/Evidencni-listi/DO110_ARSO_Odpadki_UporabniskaNavodila_5_22_21022020.pdf, https://www.gov.si/assets/organi-v-sestavi/ARSO/Odpadki/Porocilo-o-nastalih-odpadkih-in-zagotovitvi-ravnanja-z-njimi-ODP-nastajanje/Navodila-2025_ODP-nastajanje_aplikacija-IS-Odpadki.pdf

text: - **Veterinary antimicrobial-use reporting**: killed by the government application CIS VET (UVHVVR) and a small buyer base. Sources: https://www.uradni-list.si/glasilo-uradni-list-rs/vsebina/2023-01-2416/uredba-o-izvajanju-delegirane-uredbe-eu-v-zvezi-z-zahtevami-za-zbiranje-podatkov-o-obsegu-prodaje-in-uporabi-protimikrobnih-zdravil-pri-zivalih, https://www.gov.si/zbirke/storitve/registracija-dejavnosti-o-preskrbi-veterinarskih-organizacij/

name: B2B e-invoicing (ZIERDED, mandatory 1 Jan 2028)
text: - **B2B e-invoicing (ZIERDED, mandatory 1 Jan 2028)**: free state app miniBlagajna, e-invoice exchange providers, PEPPOL access points, and ERP and accounting vendors. Sources: https://www.gov.si/novice/2025-10-23-drzavni-zbor-sprejel-zakon-o-izmenjavi-elektronskih-racunov-in-drugih-elektronskih-dokumentov/, https://www.pwc.com/si/sl/aktualno/Zakon-o-izmenjavi-elektronskih-racunov-in-drugih-elektronskih-dokumentov.html

name: Working-time records (ZEPDSV-A/B)
text: - **Working-time records (ZEPDSV-A/B)**: crowded attendance-software market. ZEPDSV-B (23 Apr 2025) eased the rules, and electronic records are compulsory only for employers that have been fined. Sources: https://unija.com/sl/spremembe-pri-evidentiranju-delovnega-casa-od-23-aprila-dalje/, https://www.gov.si/novice/2024-12-02-presezeno-stevilo-ugotovljenih-krsitev-pri-vodenju-evidenc-delovnega-casa-ze-v-letu-2024/

name: Fisheries catch documentation / EU export paperwork
text: - **Fisheries catch documentation / EU export paperwork:** the Noro e-port digital Catch Documentation System (launched 2021, the first in the Pacific) and EU TRACES (Solomon Islands registered since 2015) already cover this, and the buyers are a few large processors (e.g. SolTuna). Sources: https://pina.com.fj/2021/07/23/noro-port-first-e-port-in-the-pacific-introduces-digital-catch-documents-and-tracing/, https://www.atuna.com/?p=92092

name: Customs broker declaration prep
text: - **Customs broker declaration prep:** ASYCUDA World is the government system and offers online pre-clearance. Scanned supporting documents have been mandatory since Dec 2020. There are very few brokers. Sources: https://www.sibconline.com.sb/?p=13753, https://asycuda.org/wp-content/uploads/casestudy-solomonislands.pdf

name: Tax/payroll filing for SMEs
text: - **Tax/payroll filing for SMEs:** IRD E-Tax already handles PAYE, Goods Tax and Sales Tax filing and internet-banking payment. Generic Xero/MYOB plus local accountants cover the rest. Source: https://www.ird.gov.sb/

name: Airline manifest and ticket-price reporting to SOMCAS
text: - **Airline manifest and ticket-price reporting to SOMCAS:** rejected. There are very few buyers, and airlines already rely on their departure-control and GDS vendors (Amadeus, SITA and similar) plus the free government portal.

name: Government financial management (SFMIS invoice tracking and payroll)
text: - **Government financial management (SFMIS invoice tracking and payroll):** rejected. It is a government-internal system that already has digital signatures and payroll integration, and is procured through donor-funded tenders (GTAI lists a tax-automation consulting tender). This is enterprise/government procurement, not indie software.

text: - None identified, but the market was not researched deeply enough to judge.

name: COIDA injury-on-duty medical claims (healthcare providers → Compensation Fund / CompEasy)
text:
- **COIDA injury-on-duty medical claims (healthcare providers → Compensation Fund / CompEasy).** The pain is extreme: average payment time is about 347 days, and practitioners refuse COIDA patients. But the bottleneck is the Fund's administration and payment, which software cannot fix. Intermediaries such as **CompSol** already fund and manage claims, and billing agents abound.
  - https://samedical.org/downloads/coid/coid_feb_2021.pdf
  - https://pmg.org.za/files/210421SAMA.pdf
  - https://www.moonstone.co.za/compensation-fund-vs-netcare-high-court-judgment-exposes-deep-fault-lines/

name: EPR reporting for producers
text:
- **EPR reporting for producers.** **PROs** (e.g. eWASA, plus the packaging PROs) take on registration and reporting for members, the 2025 amendments are only proposed, and smaller producers mainly pay fees through their PRO.
  - https://ewasa.org/resources/epr-waste-legislation-and-regulations-south-africa
  - https://www.iges.or.jp/sites/default/files/2026-07/3.%20EPR%20models%20and%20lessons%20from%20South%20Africa.pdf

Korea Customs Service distributes a free CBAM-PASS emissions calculator, and the ministry funds on-site measurement consulting plus verification (support expanded from 110 to 185 firms). Sources: https://www.fnnews.com/news/202506101016526321 ; https://www.heraldk.com/article/2026032903042640323 ; https://cbamguide.com/news/2026-08-20-korea-exporters-carbon-data-survey/

But the gatekeepers are the EMR vendors, which the government is pressuring with FTC review and new fines, so there is no entry point for a solo vendor. text: - **Digital Tax Stamp compliance tooling for importers.** The DTS (live from 1 July 2025) is run by SSRA and its stamp vendor, who handle stamp issuance, scanning and verification. Third-party software has no role. Source: [Orbitax](https://orbitax.com/news/country/article/South-Sudan-implements-an-elec_a9dad631-8bfe-409d-83c5-b1dc0c132ff9), [Kenya Times](https://thekenyatimes.com/latest-kenya-times-news/south-sudan-unveils-new-digital-tax-system-with-transition-deadline/).

name: SSRA eTax filing assistant for SMEs
text: - **SSRA eTax filing assistant for SMEs.** Killed by the **SSRA eTax portal itself**, by cheap local accountants, and by SMEs' inability to pay foreign SaaS. Source: [Eye Radio](https://www.eyeradio.org/revenue-authority-orders-e-tax-use-warns-against-manual-payments).

name: - None identified. The market is too small to attract competition; the problem i
text: - None identified. The market is too small to attract competition; the problem is a lack of buyers, not rivals.

name: Waste memoria compliance router
text: - **Waste memoria compliance router** (was 4.5/10 in the first pass). Under the Coordination Commission agreement under Ley 7/2022, hazardous-waste producers whose identification documents are in the e-SIR repository have fulfilled the memoria obligation, and several regions exempt them. Eurofins EcoGestor and others already generate the archive and memoria and integrate e-SIR and DIWASS. Sources: https://medioambiente.castillalamancha.es/sites/default/files/2026-06/PRODUCTOR_obligaciones.pdf, https://www.caib.es/sites/residus/es/acuerdo_comision_memoria_anual_productores_residuos/, https://www.eurofins.com/es-es/servicios-medioambientales/ecogestor/residuos/

name: Rent-a-car SES reporting
text: - **Rent-a-car SES reporting:** rental software and the net2rent-style automatic SES web-service submission; AECA guidance (https://www.aecarent.com/noticias-ID643.htm, https://net2rent.com/guia-rapida-envio-automatico-de-datos-a-ses-hospedajes/).

name: NRUA annual rental deposit
text: - **NRUA annual rental deposit:** the free N2 app from the Colegio de Registradores; Partee and Chekin guides and tools; annual (https://partee.es/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/Manual-de-instalacion-y-creacion-de-Depositos-de-Arrendamientos-en-aplicacion-N2.pdf).

name: Solar / shared self-consumption legalisation (RDL 7/2026 "gestor de autoconsumo")
text: - **Solar / shared self-consumption legalisation (RDL 7/2026 "gestor de autoconsumo"):** Wattwin, PylonData, Elecsum "+Legal", Hesstec, SolarDirecto (https://wattwin.com/, https://elecsum.com/es/comunidades-energeticas/legal/, https://cuencasolar.es/blog/el-nuevo-rdl-7-2026-crea-la-figura-del-gestor-de-autoconsumo-para-instalaciones-compartidas/).

name: Pest control / legionella records
text: - **Pest control / legionella records:** iGEO ERP (800+ companies), EviSane (https://gust.com/companies/igeoerp).

name: Plastic-packaging tax (mod. 592)
text: - **Plastic-packaging tax (mod. 592):** AHORA and Goldensoft ERP modules; Circulr for refunds (https://ahora.freshdesk.com/support/solutions/articles/154000210673-erp-impuesto-sobre-el-pl%C3%A1stico-no-reutilizable, https://circulr.es/blog/recuperar-impuesto-plastico-modelo-a22).

name: CBAM / EUDR for Spanish importers
text: - **CBAM / EUDR for Spanish importers:** pan-EU vendors (osapiens, Freyr and others); the 50 t CBAM threshold exempts most SMEs (https://www.miteco.gob.es/es/cambio-climatico/temas/cbam/actores-cbam.html, https://osapiens.com/es/preguntas-frecuentes-eudr).

name: Electrical CIE multi-region filing
text: - **Electrical CIE multi-region filing:** regional systems differ (SERIE, OGE, TECI), but installers mostly work in one region, and CYPE and dmELECT produce the documents (https://www.juntadeandalucia.es/sites/default/files/inline-files/2025/06/Manual_Usuario_TECI.pdf).

name: Electronic DeCA
text: - **Electronic DeCA:** bluecmr, logitrack, kaleidotrans, metotrans, plus the free government tool.

name: Vet PRESVET
text: - **Vet PRESVET:** clinic software already automates it (~80% of vets report via web services).

name: SILICIE
text: - **SILICIE:** AEAT system since 2020; ERP vendors; small producers exempt.

name: Packaging declaration (RD 1055/2022)

text: - B2B e-invoicing (RD 238/2026; Order in force 1 Oct 2026, so obligations from 1 Oct 2027 and 1 Oct 2028): free AEAT solution plus b2brouter, Docuten, Sage and others.

text: - Farm digital notebooks for farmers (oSIGris, Agroptima, VisualNACert, Hispatec); only the contractor niche is kept above.

name: Tea bought-leaf factory supplier payouts and Tea Board returns
text: - **Tea bought-leaf factory supplier payouts and Tea Board returns.** About 450 private bought-leaf factories make this a real workflow. It is killed by AgriGEN ERP, which specifically automates green-leaf procurement, monthly leaf-rate updates and deductions. Brokers' systems also already send tea-manufacturer invoices to RAMIS (since 1 May 2026). Sources: https://lankabusinessonline.com/?p=43897, https://www.vatupdate.com/2026/05/14/sri-lanka-expands-national-e-invoicing-pilot-with-web-api-integration-for-vat-data-transmission/

name: EPF/ETF monthly e-return automation
text: - **EPF/ETF monthly e-return automation.** E-returns are compulsory for employers with 50+ staff, and since 30 Apr 2025 uploads go only through the EPF Online Services System. It is killed by the many local payroll and HRIS packages that already generate EPF/ETF files (individual vendors not verified in this session), and by the CBSL–Labour Department integration project. Sources: https://epf.lk/?p=171, https://www.peoplesbank.lk/roastoth/2025/03/Discontinuation-Notice-of-Accepting-EPF-via-Peoples-net.pdf

name: NMRA pharmacy licence renewal helper
text: - **NMRA pharmacy licence renewal helper.** Renewal is annual, and NMRA's own online-only portal (since 21 Apr 2026) is the substitute. Low frequency. Source: https://www.nmra.gov.lk/announcements

name: EU CATCH catch-certificate tool for Sri Lankan seafood exporters
text: - **EU CATCH catch-certificate tool for Sri Lankan seafood exporters.** CATCH is mandatory only for EU importers and member-state authorities. Non-EU operators can use it voluntarily, and paper certificates are accepted with a scan until 2028. The flag-state authority (DFAR) validates certificates, and few exporters exist. Sources: https://www.seafoodsource.com/news/environment-sustainability/new-digital-catch-certificate-goes-into-effect-in-eu, https://agrinfo.eu/book-of-reports/eu-catch-certification-scheme/

name: PDPA compliance (DPO, DPIA, breach logs, ROPA), effective 1 Jan 2027 under Gazette 2498/16
text: - **PDPA compliance (DPO, DPIA, breach logs, ROPA), effective 1 Jan 2027 under Gazette 2498/16.** The deadline is real, but this is the "generic compliance" trap. Competitors include the local Xapi PDPA playbook and framework, Securiti, ISMS.online, consentstack, flexyconsent, EY Colombo and law firms. Sources: https://www.ft.lk/front-page/Data-protection-compliance-regime-takes-effect-on-1-Jan-2027/44-795776, https://www.sundaytimes.lk/260906/business-times/xapi-launches-practical-pdpa-compliance-playbook-655571.html, https://securiti.ai/pt-br/solutions/sri-lankas-personal-data-protection-act-2022

text: - **Apparel exporter EU sustainability and e-invoicing.** Large groups dominate the sector, buy through enterprise procurement and are already in the RAMIS pilot (screened through the e-invoicing searches, no separate search).

name: Customs brokerage on ASYCUDA
text: - **Customs brokerage on ASYCUDA:** killed by timing and government ownership. The ASYCUDA upgrade has been underway since 2023, and the Single Window is planned for December 2027 (indicative) and December 2028 (definitive). Sources: https://keynews.sr/asycuda-systeem-suriname-wordt-geupgraded, https://tfadatabase.org/en/members/suriname/technical-assistance-projects/article-10-4

name: Commercial waste / municipal-waste collector statistics (first-pass opportunity, 4 → 3, rejected)
text: - **Commercial waste / municipal-waste collector statistics (first-pass opportunity, 4 → 3, rejected):** confirmed that from 1 Jul 2026 professional collectors of municipal waste must report quantities by type and treatment annually (by 31 March). But it is annual only, there are two existing channels (Avfall Sverige's Avfall Web and the Naturvårdsverket e-service), and collectors run waste ERPs such as AMCS. name: EUDR for Swedish wood
text: - **EUDR for Swedish wood:** Biometria VIOL will require valid reference numbers; forest owner associations and SCA handle it; Descartes, Pinja and Stratsys sell tools. https://www.biometria.se/publikationer/informationsmaterial/avskogningsfoerordningen-eudr/ ; https://www.skogsstyrelsen.se/lag-och-tillsyn/avskogningsforordningen/

text: - **Customs CCI phase 2 / low-value imports (first-pass opportunity, 3, rejected):** confirmed CCI part 2 (simplified and supplementary declarations, entry in declarant's records) from 1 Sep 2026, but it needs Tullverket system certification and brokers or customs software dominate. https://tullverket.se/special/utkast/mia/scheduleforintroductionoftheunioncustomscode.4.7822c3691951848489354a79.html

name: OVK protocol routing
text: - **OVK protocol routing:** low pain (PDF by email or e-service), and Boverket has studied a national digital OVK solution. https://www.boverket.se/sv/om-boverket/publikationer/2023/digitalisering-av-obligatorisk-ventilationskontroll/

text: - ROT/RUT/green-tech request changes (subcontractor disclosure from 1 Jan 2027): accounting and invoicing vendors (Fortnox, Visma) will add the field.

text: - Klimatdeklaration with 2027 limit values (proposed): free BM tool, One Click LCA, consultants. https://www.regeringen.se/contentassets/eee4559302dc4ac5a904c92df5e836de/skanska-sverige-ab.pdf

name: Passar import-declaration bridge
text: - **Passar import-declaration bridge** (first-pass top idea, now 2/10). The last e-dec Import declaration is 31 Mar 2027 per the BAZG roadmap (one secondary source says 30 Sep 2027). BAZG offers Passar and the Declar web app free of charge to SMEs without customs software. Commercial direct-filing tools already exist: AEB, MIC, Declarium, trademonkey, Douana and finesolutions. Sources: https://www.bazg.admin.ch/de/roadmap-passar-2-und-3, https://www.bazg.admin.ch/de/web-anwendung-declar, https://www.aeb.com/de/magazin/artikel/passar-import-broker.php, https://trademonkey.ch/, https://douana.ch/passar-neues-zollrecht-digitalisierung-was-die-bazg-umstellung-2026-2027-fuer-ihr-unternehmen-bedeutet/, https://www.vatupdate.com/2026/05/14/passar-2-0-key-steps-and-deadlines-for-importers-in-swiss-customs-digitalization-transition/

name: French cross-border telework-day tracking (new 2026 duty)
text: - **French cross-border telework-day tracking (new 2026 duty)**. bexio Payroll already records telework and travel days and warns at the 40%/10-day limits. ELM 5.0 payroll, ISeL and tipee/Lucca cover the rest. Sources: https://www.bexio.com/fr-CH/product-update-news/decembre-2025, https://www.ge.ch/imposition-du-teletravail-personnes-frontalieres/obligations-employeur-matiere-teletravail, https://www.lucca-software.ch/blog/suivi-temps/teletravail-frontaliers-suisse

text: - **Spitex / freelance-nurse residual-financing billing**. NURSANA already bills communes (CHF 199/month), and the format is the standard Forum Datenaustausch XML. Some cantons route billing through a central clearing office. Sources: https://nursana.ch/, https://media.bs.ch/original_file/8be94ea464aba4d88e20696573c20cb3d190eecf/merkblatt-elektronische-abrechnung-spitex-2026-01-01.pdf, https://sbk-asi.ch/de/pflege-und-arbeit/freiberufliche-pflege/pflegefinanzierung

text: - **Electrician and PV grid-operator notifications**. ElektroForm / ElektroForm solar (Brunner Informatik with Swissolar's "Easy Admin" group, 400+ firms) and M2-Hub. Sources: https://www.gebaeudetechnik.ch/de/news/elektroform-solar-einfach-digital--155, https://www.primeo-energie.ch/magnolia/dam/jcr:a92a079f-871c-4dd7-8f49-706e9634a424/FAQ%20elektronisches%20Meldewesen.pdf

text: - **swissdamed device registration**. Mostly one-off. EUDAMED XML upload and an M2M API are built in, and consultancies are plentiful. Sources: https://medenvoyglobal.com/blog/eudamed-and-swissdamed-mandatory-registration-requirements/, https://decomplix.com/services/swissdamed-product-registration-in-switzerland/

text: - ZEV/vZEV/LEG billing for property managers: ista, EKZ "Gemeinsamstrom", ewl/Rapp, SH Power and other utilities (https://www.ista.com/ch/news/lokale-elektrizitaetsgemeinschaften-leg/, https://www.ekz.ch/dam/ekz/angebote/solar/stromgemeinschaften/leg-abrechnung/2026-EKZ-LEG-Abrechnung-Tarifblatt.pdf).

text: - **General SME accounting / ERP:** there are 15+ local packages (Al-Ameen and others), plus ERPNext partners and regional Arabic SaaS (Qoyod, Zoho).

name: SME GHG inventory and supplier carbon-data SaaS
text: - **SME GHG inventory and supplier carbon-data SaaS.** Rejected because the market is already crowded. 精誠 (Carbon Envision), 叡揚 (NetZero 零碳雲), 倍力 (碳管家) and 東捷 (碳捷流) all compete, and SAP covers large firms. The FSC roadmap (all listed companies complete GHG inventory by 2027, verification by 2029) drives demand, but incumbents are already selling into it. Sources: https://www.techbang.com/posts/106566-dongjie-grabs-carbon-inventory-business-opportunities-2 , https://www.cw.com.tw/article/5119837

text: - **Long-term care home-service billing and records.** Rejected because the MOHW care-management platform already runs automated claim review with self-check and resubmission, and Jubo (Smart Ageing Tech) sells home-care scheduling and record SaaS, alongside other apps such as 諾亞克居服. Sources: https://mohw.gov.tw/cp-16-36705-1.html , https://www.chanchao.com.tw/ATLife/en/visitorProductDetail.asp?no=210220 , https://apps.apple.com/tw/app/%E8%AB%BE%E4%BA%9E%E5%85%8B%E5%B1%85%E6%9C%8D/id1453627596

text: - **Migrant-worker broker paperwork.** Rejected because MOL provides a free 24-hour online application system and a foreign-worker management app, and agencies go through annual evaluation. I could not confirm a specific software gap, and the commercial agency-software landscape is unverified. Source: https://www.mol.gov.tw/1607/1632/1640/13288/post

name: ASYCUDAWorld declaration pre-fill for customs brokers
text:
- **ASYCUDAWorld declaration pre-fill for customs brokers.** ASYCUDAWorld has been mandatory for all import and export declarations since 1 Oct 2025, so the trigger is real. The idea was killed for three reasons:
  - The buyer pool is tiny: about 34 registered customs representatives.
  - ASYCUDA is free and donor-supported (UNCTAD and the World Bank CARs-4 project), with broker training already provided.
  - Large importers file through their own staff.
  Sources:
  - https://asycuda.org/tajikistan-launches-passenger-declaration-module-under-asycudaworld/
  - https://unctad.org/news/tajikistan-digital-transformation-reshaping-trade-and-connectivity
  - https://asiaplustj.info/ru/news/tajikistan/economic/20250929/v-tadzhikistane-vvoditsya-novaya-sistema-tamozhennogo-oformleniya-chto-ona-soboi-predstavlyaet

name: Cannabis dispensary compliance (ภ.ท. monthly reports and prescriptions)
text:
- **Cannabis dispensary compliance (ภ.ท. monthly reports and prescriptions):**
  - Cannabox POS advertises built-in automation of the ภ.ท.28 report.
  - Klu POS calls itself Thailand's #1 dispensary POS, with prescription handling.
  - The market is also shrinking. A ministerial regulation (No. 2, B.E. 2569) took effect on 30 Apr 2026 and limits sellers to clinics, pharmacies and registered herbal shops. 18,433 establishments existed at end-2025, but 8,636 licences expired and only 1,339 were renewed.
  - Sources:

name: GHG reporting under the draft Climate Change Act
text:
- **GHG reporting under the draft Climate Change Act:**
  - Cabinet approved the draft on 2 Dec 2025, but it is not yet in force.
  - It covers about 3,000–4,000 large organisations, with verification by TGO-registered bodies.
  - The buyers are large, already served by carbon consultants and software, and a ministerial regulation is still pending.
  - Sources:
    - https://www.nortonrosefulbright.com/en/knowledge/publications/2af90ff7/the-impact-of-thailand-climate-change-bill
    - https://chandler.morihamada.com/en/insights/newsletters/7231

name: Customs declaration helper for brokers/importers
text: - **Customs declaration helper for brokers/importers.** Killed by **ASYCUDA World / TileSW**, the UNCTAD-built state system (single window live since Feb 2021, linking partner agencies and TradeInvest). Brokers are licensed and trained to file the DAU directly in it, the broker pool is small, and no third-party integration layer is evident. Sources: https://customs.gov.tl/doing-business/customs-brokers/ , https://asycuda.org/timor-lestes-electronic-single-windows-increasing-capabilities/

name: Oil & gas local-content supplier registration/reporting
text: - **Oil & gas local-content supplier registration/reporting.** Killed by **operator-run processes (Santos supplier interest forms) and consultants (e.g., Worley capability mapping)**. Enterprise procurement and very few buyers. Bayu-Undan is in decommissioning and the Greater Sunrise framework is still not final. Sources: https://www.santos.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/TL-Suppliers-Info-slides-for-engagement-May-2022-Rev-2.pdf , https://insights.worley.com/case-studies/mapping-and-development-of-industry-capabilities-in-timor-leste

name: Payroll for foreign employers
text: - **Payroll for foreign employers.** Killed by **EOR vendors** (Rivermate, Ontop, Asanify, Deel), which already publish Timor-Leste payroll/INSS handling.

name: EUDR coffee traceability
text: - **EUDR coffee traceability** (global vendors such as TraceX and others, plus certifier/donor tools). Listed above only as a weak watchlist item.

name: Customs-broker declaration automation (Port of Lomé)
text: - **Customs-broker declaration automation (Port of Lomé):** blocked by the SEGUCE Togo single window, run by Bureau Veritas BIVAC and Soget. It is the mandatory, integrated platform for all import, export and transit formalities, which leaves no realistic third-party integration layer for a solo founder. Sources: https://verigates.bureauveritas.com/node/61, https://tfadatabase.org/en/uploads/thematicdiscussiondocument/Mise_en_oeuvre_de_lAFE-par_le_CNFE_Togo_Corrige.pdf

name: Payroll and social filings as a standalone product
text: - **Payroll and social filings as a standalone product:** made largely unnecessary by the CNSS's own Excel import for the DRC, plus existing payroll packages and accountants. Kept above only at 3/10.

text: - None confirmed in Togo. For e-invoicing, the threat is a free OTR platform plus international vendors (EDICOM) and regional accounting SaaS (CassKai), not saturation.

text: - **Consumption Tax / SME bookkeeping compliance:** Killed by Xero/MYOB plus local accounting firms. 15% CT, TOP 100,000 registration threshold; I found no 2025–26 e-invoicing mandate. Sources: https://taxatlas.io/country/tonga/vat-sales-tax, https://aviaanaccounting.com/accounting-firms-in-tonga/

text: - **Customs entry automation:** Killed by ASYCUDA World (UNCTAD, government-run) and the Tonga Trade Portal. Brokers are optional and few. Sources: https://tonga.tradeportal.org/procedure/153?l=en, https://matangitonga.to/tag/customs?page=1

name: Quarantine/biosecurity records
text: - **Quarantine/biosecurity records:** Killed by the donor-funded government Quarantine Management Information System. Source: https://pacerplus.org/tag/committee-on-sps-and-tbt/

name: - SME accounting/tax (Xero, MYOB, local firms)
text: - SME accounting/tax (Xero, MYOB, local firms).

name: E-invoicing compliance tool

name: Fisheries licence and logsheet compliance tool for vessels licensed in Tuvalu
text: - **Fisheries licence and logsheet compliance tool for vessels licensed in Tuvalu.** The Tuvalu Fisheries Authority's *Fisheries Management Regulations 2025* (published in 2026) set out permit and licensing procedures, vessel reporting obligations and mandatory Automatic Location Communicators (ALCs). This looked like a textbook regulatory trigger. It was killed by **SPC's TUFMAN2**, a cloud tuna data system for Pacific Island countries that takes data directly from SPC's e-reporting apps (**Tails, OnBoard, OnShore, OLLO**), by **iFIMS** (integrated observer and catch e-reporting), and by the **PNA / FFA vessel-registration and VMS systems**. These are free or donor-funded tools, mandated at regional level, with fleet-level buyers outside Tuvalu.

name: Military registration and booking-exemption automation for employers
text:
- **Military registration and booking-exemption automation for employers.** This looked very strong: every employer is obliged, the rules change often (Resolution 916 of July 2025 changed the forms, and Resolution No. 812 brought new rules from 27 June 2026), there are monthly and 5- and 7-day notification deadlines, and penalties apply. It was killed because the state launched a **free Дія service on 13 Aug 2026**. In it, companies get data from the Оберіг register, update employee data and carry out reconciliation with ТЦК online. HR suites (BAS ЗУП-type modules, appendix-5 list templates) already cover the paperwork. The data is also highly sensitive, and the workflow could shrink sharply after demobilisation. Sources:

Accreditation is required before anyone can sell, and the buyer pool is too small to fight two incumbents.

name: VNPF schedule generator for employers
text: - **VNPF schedule generator for employers.** A 2026 rate change took the rate from 8% to 12%. The free **VNPF Online Employer Portal**, payroll/EOR tools (Ontop, Carbonate) and accountants killed it. The task is monthly but simple, and the rate change is a one-off.

name: - VSMS fiscal integration (FiscoBridge, AJC Bridge, DTI platform)
text: - VSMS fiscal integration (FiscoBridge, AJC Bridge, DTI platform).

name: SENIAT digital invoicing (Prov. 0102/0121)
text: - **SENIAT digital invoicing (Prov. 0102/0121):** Killed by the homologation requirement plus incumbents: EDICOM, SENIAT-authorized local imprentas digitales, and ERPs (Galac, Profit Plus). Mandatory compliance has applied since March 2025, so the window has closed. Sources: [Acceso a la Justicia](https://accesoalajusticia.org/regulacion-del-uso-de-medios-digitales-para-la-emision-de-facturas-y-otros-documentos-fiscales/), [PwC note](https://www.pwc.com/ve/es/assets/documentos/stl/Nota-de-actualidad-Medios-Digitales-para-Facturas-2025.pdf), [EDICOM](https://edicomgroup.com/es/blog/factura-digital-venezuela).

name: Multi-portal payroll filing (IVSS/TIUNA, BANAVIH FAOV, INCES, 9% pension contribution)
text: - **Multi-portal payroll filing (IVSS/TIUNA, BANAVIH FAOV, INCES, 9% pension contribution):** Killed by local payroll modules (Galac, Profit Plus Nómina, Saint) and foreign EOR/payroll providers. Sources: [Baker McKenzie on the pension contribution](https://insightplus.bakermckenzie.com/bm/tax/venezuela-special-contribution-created-for-the-protection-of-social-security-pensions), [Playroll](https://www.playroll.com/payroll/venezuela).

name: Inflation-adjustment and multi-currency accounting
text: - **Inflation-adjustment and multi-currency accounting:** Killed by Galac's dedicated AxI module ([brochure](https://galac.com/PDF/Productos/Brochures/Brochure_AxI.pdf)).

name: Pharmacy controlled-drug reporting
text: - **Pharmacy controlled-drug reporting:** Dropped because I could not find any verifiable current Venezuelan digital requirement.

name: - SENIAT invoicing, payroll filing, IVA/ISLR withholding inside ERPs, and inflat
text: - SENIAT invoicing, payroll filing, IVA/ISLR withholding inside ERPs, and inflation-adjustment accounting (Galac, Profit Plus/Softech, Saint, TOTVS, EDICOM).

name: - About 5 million household businesses move from presumptive tax to declaration
text: - About 5 million household businesses move from presumptive tax to declaration.

name: - Cash-register e-invoices are required at ≥1bn VND annual revenue; households a
text: - Cash-register e-invoices are required at ≥1bn VND annual revenue; households at or below 1bn VND are reported as exempt from VAT and PIT.

name: MISA (eShop, meInvoice)
text: - Killed by **MISA (eShop, meInvoice)**, **Bizzi**, POS vendors such as Sapo and KiotViet [B], and free GDT tools. ARPU is tiny.

name: - One sub-niche remains untested: multi-client filing for tax agents, plus recon
text: - One sub-niche remains untested: multi-client filing for tax agents, plus reconciliation of e-commerce platform-withheld tax (Decree 117/2025 [B]).

text: - Killed by MISA eShop, Sapo, ACMan/AC-Invoice, TH-APP and others. MISA lists 13 tools.

text:

**EPR packaging and product reporting (Decree 05/2025).**

name: - Packaging revenue under 30bn VND/yr is exempt, the filing is annual (by 31 Mar
text: - Packaging revenue under 30bn VND/yr is exempt, the filing is annual (by 31 March), and most firms simply pay the Fund contribution.

text: - Consultants and the industry PRO cover the rest, so this is not an SME software market.

name: CBAM for steel and fastener exporters
text: - **CBAM for steel and fastener exporters:** many CBAM SaaS tools and certification bodies; enterprise buyers.

name: EUDR for coffee, rubber and wood
text: - **EUDR for coffee, rubber and wood:** crowded EUDR platforms plus government and large-exporter in-house systems.

name: Clinic EMR (Circular 13/2025/TT-BYT) and BHYT XML export
text: - **Clinic EMR (Circular 13/2025/TT-BYT) and BHYT XML export:** many HIS and clinic vendors.

name: Pharmacy drug-database and e-prescription connection
text: - **Pharmacy drug-database and e-prescription connection:** pharmacy POS vendors already integrate.

name: Import clearance document pack (UNVIM + customs)
text: - **Import clearance document pack (UNVIM + customs):** killed by OFAC/FTO exposure for Hodeidah importers and by UN/ASYCUDA systems that third parties cannot access. Freight forwarders and clearing agents in Djibouti and Dubai already do this work manually as a service.

name: Exchange-house transfer reporting
text: - **Exchange-house transfer reporting:** killed by CBY-Aden's mandated UNMONEY network, which is regulator-provided infrastructure, plus bank-grade core-banking vendors.

name: - None identified. The market never got as far as competitive analysis
text: - None identified. The market never got as far as competitive analysis.

name: Smart Invoice issuing integration (ERP/POS to VSDC)
text: - **Smart Invoice issuing integration (ERP/POS to VSDC).** Killed by a crowded integrator field: Greytrix (Sage), Serpa (Odoo), Upbuff (SAP B1), Satva, Flick Network, Pay-e Zambia, Zamsmart, Edicom and ClearTax. Fiscal devices cover the smallest shops.

name: Payroll statutory returns (PAYE/SDL, NAPSA, NHIMA, 2026 PAYE bands)
text: - **Payroll statutory returns (PAYE/SDL, NAPSA, NHIMA, 2026 PAYE bands).** Killed by the Odoo `l10n_zm_payroll` module (v18 and v19), Sage payroll and local platforms (Satva built one for a Zambian client). This is an annual band update, not a new workflow.

name: ZPPA / government-vendor document packs as a standalone product
text: - **ZPPA / government-vendor document packs as a standalone product.** This is generic document collection. ZPPA e-GP registration is free. The useful part is folded into opportunity 2.

name: - ZRA Smart Invoice issuing (see above)
text: - ZRA Smart Invoice issuing (see above).

name: - Payroll statutory computation and returns (see above)
text: - Payroll statutory computation and returns (see above).

name: ZIMRA fiscalisation reconciliation (FDMS)
text:
- **ZIMRA fiscalisation reconciliation (FDMS).** Fiscalisation is mandatory, but there are many
  ZIMRA-accredited fiscal-device, POS and ERP vendors, and accounting packages already cover it.
  I could not verify an exception-handling gap. The rejection is **provisional**: I could not
  check the vendor landscape (search refused).

name: - ZIMRA fiscal devices and POS (see above; provisional)
text: - ZIMRA fiscal devices and POS (see above; provisional).

name: Street vendors and markets
text: - **Street vendors and markets.** The state already issues digital vendor cards via the Citizen Portal (DP 111/24), and the vendors have no money.

name: Taxi/minibus licensing helper
text: - **Taxi/minibus licensing helper.** The Vehicle and Road Traffic (Amendment) Act 2025 raised licence fees and confused operators (Antigua Observer, https://antiguaobserver.com/?p=308653 and https://antiguaobserver.com/?p=309199). But renewal is annual, it is handled through associations (UTC and others) and at the Transport Board counter, and the pain is about cost, not paperwork. The sector is getting two seats on the Transport Board (https://antiguaobserver.com/?p=320626), so the problem is being solved politically, not with software.

name: Heritage Quay vendor registration
text: - **Heritage Quay vendor registration.** About 150 vendors register with SJDC (https://sjdcanu.com/vendors_mall); a one-off registration with no recurring filing.

name: Household employers of domestic workers
Pest control and tank cleaning certificates (CABA)
text: - **Pest control and tank cleaning certificates (CABA):** APRA's EDA system already sells and generates certificates online with QR stickers (since 2015). Other municipalities are fragmented but small, and no 2025–2026 trigger was found.

name: Street-taxi compliance
text: - **Street-taxi compliance** (licence, receipt per ride, 5% cash duty in 2026). Platforms handle receipts for most rides, and the remaining drivers are individuals who use eHDM apps. Source: https://www.arka.am/en/news/business/new_taxi_regulations_in_armenia_to_take_effect_on_september_1

name: Pawnshops and exchange offices
text: - **Pawnshops and exchange offices.** Licensed by the CBA and recurring, but few independent operators, mature CBA reporting, and likely covered by local accounting vendors (unverified). I'd revisit them only with access to the CBA's reporting form list. Sources: https://arlis.am/en/acts/182322, regalert.today CBA resolutions

name: Pawnbrokers / second-hand dealers
text: - **Pawnbrokers / second-hand dealers:** NSW Police Weblink with a published dealer software specification and approved record-keeping software. A mature ecosystem.

name: Household employers
text: - **Household employers:** Pay The Nanny, NannyPay, Domestic Payroll and CarePayCo. Payday Super and the SBSCH closure were absorbed by these services and payroll apps.

name: Mobile food vendors
text: - **Mobile food vendors:** the NSW mutual-recognition reform (2025) and Vic Streatrader shrink the fragmentation.

name: Household employers (DLS)
text: - **Household employers (DLS):** free DLS-Online. Households don't buy software.

name: Tattoo studios, taxis
text: - **Tattoo studios, taxis:** not offline, or already served by apps.

name: Livestock identification and the move to an electronic animal exchange
text:
- **Livestock identification and the move to an electronic animal exchange:**
  - The trigger is strong: 28 animal markets were closed in Oct 2025 over foot-and-mouth disease and veterinary-sanitary failures, and markets will move to an exchange where buyers see identification data online.
  - But AQTA vets tag the animals and enter the data into AQTİS themselves, and the state will build the exchange.
  - So there is no private buyer for software. At most there might one day be a tender.
  - Sources: [azinforum](https://azinforum.az/iqtisadiyyat/azerbaycanda-enenevi-heyvan-bazarlari-baglanir-mal-qara-birjalarda-satilacaq), [banker.az](https://banker.az/t%C9%99s%C9%99rrufatlarda-heyvanlarin-identifikasiyasi-baslanib/), [bayraqdar.info](https://www.bayraqdar.info/2026/09/22/heyvanlarin-identifikasiyasi-v%C9%99-ucotu-uzr%C9%99-t%C9%99dbirl%C9%99r-davam-edir/).

name: Taxi operators
text: - **Taxi operators:** a one-off permit renewed every 7 years. AYNA and Bolt already cover the flow.

name: Bazaar traders
text: - **Bazaar traders:** e-kassa vendors and the State Tax Service own this.

name: Jitney and taxi franchise compliance
text: - **Jitney and taxi franchise compliance.** There is a single receiving body (the Road Traffic Department Franchise Unit, which works by counter and phone), and renewal is annual. The owner-drivers have no software budget. Sources: https://www.roadtraffic.gov.bs/?p=5085, https://roadtraffic.gov.bs/?p=3391

name: Straw Market vendor fees
text: - **Straw Market vendor fees.** The obligation is fee payment to one Authority, and enforcement is by lockout. Only the Authority itself could buy a system, through government procurement. Sources: https://www.tribune242.com/comments/cr/124/15455/, https://www.tribune242.com/comments/cr/124/68195/, https://ewnews.com/?p=97622

name: Enhanced WPS for SMEs
text:
- **Enhanced WPS for SMEs.** Not a quiet industry. It covers all private employers, and banks and
  payroll vendors file it.

name: Tobacco digital stamps
text: - **Tobacco digital stamps.** NBR's own app covers the retailer side.

name: Overseas recruiting agencies
text: - **Overseas recruiting agencies.** They looked like a fit for the "one job, many receiving authorities" pattern (BMET clearance plus destination-country visa portals). They are rejected because BMET's A-RMS, RAIMS and OEP are free and already used by about 85% of agencies, and commercial recruitment software such as Palazon exists.

name: Street vendors under the National Vending Act
text: - **Street vendors under the National Vending Act:** the dispute is about licence renewal and location; there's no money in it. Source: https://barbadostoday.bb/2025/12/17/whither-the-vendors-act-four-years-on/

name: Heating-attest apps (three regions)
text: - **Heating-attest apps (three regions).** Testo Pro+ and EuroSoft Attest already issue Flemish, Brussels and Walloon certificates on site.

name: PAB/PVB budget-holder payroll
text: - **PAB/PVB budget-holder payroll.** Social secretariats, Helpper, Partner in Assistentie and budget-holder associations already do it.

name: Flemish taxi operators
text: - **Flemish taxi operators.** Licensing is one-off, and trips already run through apps.

name: Domestic-worker CNSS declarations
text: - **Domestic-worker CNSS declarations.** The obligation is real and enforced (2023 ultimatum, criminal penalties), but CNSS, DGI and ASIN built the free "Gens de maison" platform, linked to ANIP, in Nov 2023. The substitute is the state platform plus the household's own accountant. The leftover (payslips) is a generic payroll app.

name: Private-school EducMaster double entry
text: - **Private-school EducMaster double entry.** The state platform is free and mandatory, with no known API. School management software is a crowded generic category. Revisit only if EducMaster opens a CSV import that third-party tools could feed.

name: Moto-taxi licensing and professional cards
text: - **Moto-taxi licensing and professional cards.** A municipal B2G system, and drivers pay XOF 4,800 a year. Nothing for an indie vendor.

name: Livestock / transhumance
text: - **Livestock / transhumance.** State vets issue the certificates. Cross-border transhumance is restricted. Herders don't buy software.

name: Meat shops / abattoirs
text: - **Meat shops / abattoirs:** the Livestock Bill 2025 was still in re-deliberation in Jun 2026. Slaughter is religiously sensitive, the shop count is small, and the BAFRA permits are issued by inspectors. Sources: https://thebhutanese.bt/national-assembly-accepts-ncs-changes-in-livestock-bill-of-bhutan-2025/, https://asianews.network/?p=279462, https://thebhutanese.bt/despite-bafra-assurances-meat-vendors-and-restaurants-sell-and-serve-rotting-meat/

name: Micro traders / street vendors
text: - **Micro traders / street vendors:** micro trade is de-licensed and the street-vending rules are not yet written. Sources: https://leap.unep.org/en/countries/bt/national-legislation/bhutan-micro-trade-regulation-2006, https://thebhutanese.bt/moice-minister-says-street-vendors-will-be-allowed-but-with-rules-and-specified-locations/

name: Taxi
text: - **Taxi:** the licence is one-off; fiscalization is covered by POS vendors (see the country report).

name: Livestock trader, agent and feedlot permits during the 2026 FMD crisis
text: - **Livestock trader, agent and feedlot permits during the 2026 FMD crisis.** The trigger is real: suspected FMD from 28 Jan 2026, all movement permits revoked, the EU withdrew fresh-beef authorisation on 21 Apr 2026, and internal movement eased on 5 May 2026. But permits and BAITS (registration, transfers, treatments, deaths) are free government systems, run through DVS offices and **BAITS cafés/agents**. The cafés are the substitute and already the offline channel. Buyer licences fall under Cap 36:01, and the number of licensees is unknown. This is a government or donor project, not indie SaaS.

name: RENAVE for used-car lots
text:
- **RENAVE for used-car lots.**
  - The strongest trigger found: mandatory nationwide from 28 Sep 2026.
  - Killed by at least 6 homologated integrators and dealer-software vendors already selling it: BNDV, Revenda Mais, Autoconf, RenaveFácil, RenaveAuto, Trillia B3.
  - Becoming an integrator also requires homologation by Senatran, the federal traffic secretariat.
  - Sources: https://www.portaldotransito.com.br/noticias/renave-torna-se-obrigatorio-nacionalmente-saiba-o-que-muda-para-lojistas-e-consumidores/amp/ ; https://bndv.com.br/renave ; https://www.renaveauto.com.br/

name: Auto-dismantler parts tagging
text: - **Auto-dismantler parts tagging.** The DETRANs credential the tag-and-software suppliers (e.g., Valid in Goiás), and the regime has been mature since 2018. Sources: https://www.jornalopcao.com.br/ultimas-noticias/lei-do-desmanche-lojas-de-pecas-e-desmontes-precisam-se-cadastrar-ate-o-dia-31-de-julho-130290/ ; https://www.legisweb.com.br/legislacao/?id=482844

name: FNRH Digital for pousadas
text: - **FNRH Digital for pousadas.** The free government module is designed for lodgings without a PMS, and PMS vendors integrate through the API. Sources: https://brasilturis.com.br/2026/03/26/hoteis-e-pousadas-devem-adotar-ficha-digital-de-hospedes-ate-20-de-abril/ ; https://myfrontdesk.cloudbeds.com/hc/en-us/articles/42670351711899-Brazil-New-Guest-Reporting-Requirement-FNRH

name: Dumpster-rental e-CTR router
text:
- **Dumpster-rental e-CTR router.**
  - The fragmentation pattern fits the Florida grease benchmark, but there are at least 7 vertical tools, the cheapest from R$199.90 per month.
  - Before reviving the idea, check whether these tools file to each city's e-CTR portal.
  - Sources: https://www.residuosonline.com.br/ ; https://enkad.com.br/software-para-locacao-de-cacambas/ ; https://www.saopaulo.sp.leg.br/blog/secretario-adia-fiscalizacao-eletronica-sobre-destinacao-de-cacambas/

name: Independent driving instructors
text: - **Independent driving instructors.** Government app plus generic scheduling.

name: Jewellers' AML (DPMS)
text: - **Jewellers' AML (DPMS):** Too few shops. Regional AML vendors (e.g. Arctic Intelligence) already cover Brunei. Source: https://arctic-intelligence.com/countries/compliance-brunei

name: Household employers of domestic workers (direct)
text: - **Household employers of domestic workers (direct):** Households act through agencies. They are consumers, not software buyers.

name: Livestock movement certificates
text: - **Livestock movement certificates:** issued by the communal vet; the trader pays per certificate and has no reason to buy software. The state is the only buyer.

name: Private security companies
text: - **Private security companies:** only about 25 approved firms. Prefects' inspections are campaign-based, and the payroll/CNPS side is already served by Odoo and Sage (see the main report).

name: Fishing ELOGs
text: - **Fishing ELOGs:** mandatory expansion in 2026, but DFO-qualified app market exists (VeriCatch and others) and harvesters resist even CAD 60/season. Sources: https://www.dfo-mpo.gc.ca/elogs, https://ffaw.ca/notice-to-fish-harvesters-electronic-logbook-elog-implementation-2026-fishing-season-nf-26-006/, https://vericatch.com/dfo-elogs-choose-your-preferred-provider/

name: Ontario neonic seed vendors
text: - **Ontario neonic seed vendors:** sales reporting removed in 2020. Source: https://cela.ca/guest-blog-phase-in-of-ontarios-neonic-regulation-hits-new-milestone/

name: Pharmacy and depot compliance
text: - **Pharmacy and depot compliance:** Bangui officines are capped at about 20. The December 2025 crackdown hit informal "mini pharma" sellers, who are not software buyers. Sources: https://acap-rca.com/2025/12/04/le-collectif-des-vendeurs-des-produits-pharmaceutiques-denonce-la-fermeture-de-leurs-officines/, https://www.sangonet.com/afriqg/PAFF/Dic/santC/medicam-gachis-rca.html

name: Rural sanitary services (SSR) management
text: - **Rural sanitary services (SSR) management:** APR Software already serves more than 300 of about 2,600 SSR, and the buyers are cash-poor volunteer committees.

name: Agricultural-intermediary registration
text: - **Agricultural-intermediary registration:** a one-off DT registration. The recurring payroll work is served by payroll SaaS.

name: Hotel and homestay guest registration
text: - **Hotel and homestay guest registration:** the police app or system is mandatory. There's no room for a third-party workflow layer.

name: Reverse invoicing for recyclers (反向开票)
text:
- **Reverse invoicing for recyclers (反向开票):** the strongest money-backed workflow found (13,300 enterprises, a 2024 trigger), but 开灵科技 and e-invoicing incumbents already sell scale-to-invoice systems, and they need tax-platform access.
---

name: Domestic-worker employers (Ley 2466/2025)
text: - **Domestic-worker employers (Ley 2466/2025).** New duties (written contract, PILA for by-the-day workers). Symplifica and Nómina en Línea (Aportes en Línea) already cover contracts, social-security enrolment, payroll and settlement. It's a B2C trap.

name: Domestic-worker payroll for households
text:
- **Domestic-worker payroll for households.**
  - About 170,575 workers, only about 14% properly insured. Employers must register with CCSS within 8 days and buy INS RT-Hogar.
  - CCSS's Oficina Virtual has a dedicated domestic module with automatic bank debit, and part-time contribution bases exist.
  - mabbi.app already targets domestic employers.
  - The remaining problem is informality, which depends on households choosing to comply. That is not a workflow gap.
  - Sources: https://www.ccss.sa.cr/web/trabajadora-domestica/ ; https://elmundo.cr/costa-rica/aseguramiento-de-trabajadoras-domesticas-sobrepasa-expectativas-de-la-ccss/ ; https://mabbi.app/incapacidad-empleada-domestica-ccss-ins/

name: Herd-management app for ranchers
text: - **Herd-management app for ranchers.** Identigan and GanApp already sell to ranchers using the areteo as their hook, and Trazar-Agro's own app is free.

name: Small-scale fishermen catch logging (2026 rules)
text: - **Small-scale fishermen catch logging (2026 rules):** The state provides free mOčevidnik, eOčevidnik and mRecFish apps ([morski.hr](https://www.morski.hr/od-1-sijecnja-novi-pravilnik-o-dostavi-podataka-o-ulovu-u-gospodarskom-ribolovu/), [Glas Istre, May 2026](https://www.glasistre.hr/more-i-nautika/2026/05/24/idete-u-ribolov-novi-pravilnik-donosi-obvezu-koja-se-mnogima-nece-svidjeti-1071039)).

name: Taxi and street-vendor licence/tax helper
text: - **Taxi and street-vendor licence/tax helper:** the burden is real, but there is no payment rail and the free substitute is WhatsApp or Telegram groups plus a contador.

name: All mipyme-facing ideas
text:
- **All mipyme-facing ideas:** see the country report (MINCOM-certified software, sanctions, payment rails).
---

name: Scrap metal dealer register software
text: - **Scrap metal dealer register software:** enforcement exists (https://cyprus-mail.com/2026/07/23/over-a-tonne-of-electricity-cables-seized-by-police-overnight), but no purchase-register or reporting duty was found, only 20 premises were inspected, and the trade is small and cash-based. No evidence of recurring regulator filings.

name: Domestic-worker payroll/payslip app
text: - **Domestic-worker payroll/payslip app:** Social Insurance and the Migration Department are the receiving bodies, but households are consumers who will not pay SaaS prices.

name: Grower fruit distilleries
text: - **Grower fruit distilleries.** 541 operators keep per-batch records and file a monthly excise return. Already served by SYScore "SW evidence pěstitelské pálenice" (XML export for Customs), Hradecký Pacov's program and the free Customs EPP template. No 2026 change. Sources: https://www.syscore.cz/index.php/prodej/prodej-sw-evidence-pestitelske-palenice , https://celnisprava.gov.cz/cz/dane/WebSPD/WebLih/Stranky/VzoryPP.aspx , https://www.e15.cz/byznys/potraviny/pocet-registrovanych-palenic-dal-stoupa-834027

name: Hunting associations
text: - **Hunting associations.** 5,778 hunting grounds and new NV 24/2026 wild-boar subsidy rules from 1 Sep 2026, but the market is crowded: iHonitba (auto-generates MYSL forms), eMyslivost, Hunterra, the free "Evidence myslivosti", and a comparison site. Sources: https://ihonitba.cz/ , https://www.myslivecke-aplikace.cz/ , https://www.cmmj.cz/myslivecke-prispevky-maji-od-zari-nova-pravidla/ , https://csu.gov.cz/vykazy/mysl-mze-1-01-rocni-vykaz-o-honitbach-stavu-a-lovu-zvere-od-1-dubna-2025-do-31-brezna-2026_psz_2025

name: Small waterworks software
text:
- **Small waterworks software:** close to rejected, because Danske Vandværker's Tethys and its paper
  system already serve the segment (kept above only as a service angle).

name: Khat import tax and licence compliance
text: - **Khat import tax and licence compliance.** Killed by concentration. Imports run through a few licensed importers, historically the SOGIK monopoly. Per-kg taxes are collected at entry by the state. Retail vendors have no filing obligation. Sources: https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/732701468247481705/pdf/628230FRENCH0P0KHAT0Banque0mondiale.pdf , https://www.icij.org/investigations/collateraldamage/qats-soothing-effects-mask-its-true-roles-revenue-and-control/ , https://prame.openum.ca/2025/10/15/khat-et-geopolitique-a-djibouti/

name: Household employer CNSS / payslips for domestic workers
text: - **Household employer CNSS / payslips for domestic workers.** Killed by informality. ILO says the 2006 Labour Code and CNSS cover only regular migrants, many Ethiopian migrants work informally, and ILO recommends regularisation. I found no Djibouti-specific household declaration scheme of the kind Morocco and Benin run. The general payroll case is already covered (and scored 3/10) in the country report. Sources: https://www.ilo.org/media/89446/download , https://www.ilo.org/sites/default/files/wcmsp5/groups/public/@africa/@ro-abidjan/@sro-addis_ababa/documents/publication/wcms_867976.pdf

name: Money changers / remittance operators
text: - **Money changers / remittance operators.** Killed by the small buyer count. There are 18 operators, all on the BCD's public list, and AML tooling is crowded. Sources: https://banque-centrale.dj/les-etablissements-agrees/ , https://migrantmoney.uncdf.org/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/Djibouti-Diagnostic-Report-FR.pdf

name: Market vendors, beekeepers, second-hand dealers
text: - **Market vendors, beekeepers, second-hand dealers:** populations too small and informal; not checked further.

name: Pharmacy controlled-drug reporting
text: - **Pharmacy controlled-drug reporting:** the regulator's own portal, DNCD Digital (launched 2022), already covers all 1,259 Class B pharmacies ([El Día](https://eldia.com.do/dncd-cambia-forma-de-adquirir-medicamentos/), [Minpre annual report](https://memorias.minpre.gob.do/api/documents/3282/download)).

name: Used-car lots, transfer paperwork
text: - **Used-car lots, transfer paperwork:** the bottleneck was ANT being closed (Jan–Mar 2026), not a workflow software can fix. Their UAFE duty is covered by opportunity 2. ([Primicias](https://www.primicias.ec/sociedad/suspension-temporal-compra-venta-carros-nuevos-usados-ant-115093/))

name: Bus and microbus subsidy compliance
text: - **Bus and microbus subsidy compliance.** The compensation requires GPS with real-time transmission to the VMT; hardware vendors do this. Operators are squeezed and paid up to 6 months late. 9,092 permits. (https://www.elsalvador.com/dinero-y-negocios/transporte-autobuses-viceministerio-de-el-salvador/1277676/2026/ ; https://asamblea.gob.sv/node/11861)

name: Malabo market traders
text: - **Malabo market traders:** the burden is in-person tax collection by municipal inspectors, which press reports describe as often diverted ([Diario Rombe](https://diariorombe.es/magazine/el-mercado-central-de-malabo-lugar-paradogicamente-emblematico-de-la-ciudad/), [Diario Rombe on reform](https://diariorombe.es/ultimas-noticias/la-alcaldesa-malabo-obliga-los-comerciantes-reformar-mercado-central-malabo-propios-recursos/)). That is a governance problem, not a software one.

name: Money changers
text: - **Money changers:** informal, and foreign exchange is already covered by the BEAC import file in the country report.

name: Import-licence paperwork service
text: - **Import-licence paperwork service.** The pain is real (reports of more red tape on import licences). The substitute is personal relationships at MOTI and with the state forex allocation, and no software can address that.

name: Coastal fishing logbooks
text: - **Coastal fishing logbooks.** Substitute: the free PERK app (perk.agri.ee), which files to two agencies at once. Sources: https://www.agri.ee/uudised/kalurid-saavad-hakata-puugiandmeid-esitama-mobiilirakenduses, https://pta.agri.ee/ettevotjale-tootjale-ja-turustajale/kutseline-kalapuuk

name: Livestock market traders and export suppliers
text:
- **Livestock market traders and export suppliers.** The government ETLITS (MoA, built with
  USAID, EU, AU and World Bank support) is the traceability system. Proclamation 819/2014
  licensing is a one-off. A draft directive would remove brokers altogether. Traders pay in cash
  and have no software budget.
  ([Reporter](https://www.thereporterethiopia.com/39833/),
  [ETLITS](https://etlits.moa.gov.et/who-we-are),
  [LEAP/FAOLEX](https://leap.unep.org/en/countries/et/national-legislation/live-animals-marketing-proclamation-no-8192014))

name: Cattle movement permits
text: - **Cattle movement permits:** BAF authorises each movement itself under its SOPs. The users are smallholders, and there is nothing for third-party software to plug into.

name: Household employer FNPF
text: - **Household employer FNPF:** households won't pay, coverage is voluntary, and payroll tools exist. The FNPF cut to 8% from 1 Aug 2026 is a payroll-vendor update, not an opening.

name: Inland fishermen's catch report
text: - **Inland fishermen's catch report:** filed once a year, with an official web system and app. Source: https://ssak.fi/saalisilmoitus/

name: Seasonal farm-worker housing and permits
text:
- **Seasonal farm-worker housing and permits:**
  - About 2,300 seasonal work certificates a year and a few hundred farm employers.
  - The obligations (Migri accommodation guidance, written tenancy, OSH inspections) are per season, and the permit side runs through Migri.
  - Too few buyers for software. At most an employer-union service.
  - Sources: https://migri.fi/en/accommodation-for-seasonal-workers, https://tyosuojelu.fi/-/tyosuojeluviranomaisen-viesti-maatalouden-tyonantajille, https://migri.fi/documents/5202425/7004840/TY6_plus_Liitelomake+kausity%C3%B6t%C3%A4+koskevaan+hakemukseen_fi.pdf/aa21d03b-e62e-0d05-8941-2700295986bd?t=1770215855848, https://emn.fi/wp-content/uploads/EMN_EN_Maahanmuuton_tunnusluvut_2025_EN.pdf

name: Scrap and second-hand dealers
text: - **Scrap and second-hand dealers:** no police dealer register was found. The waste side belongs to the SIIRTO vendors.

name: Collective-pool surveillance, 2027 transfer from the ARS to operators
text: - **Collective-pool surveillance, 2027 transfer from the ARS to operators:** This was the best trigger found (décret 2026-118 and arrêté of 23 June 2026, in force 1 Jan 2027, covering campsites, hotels and residences). It is killed by competition: Becarepool, Poolog (Neptech), Aquatycia, E-Carnet, Naly and Piscilog already sell digital carnets sanitaires. The accredited labs that will run the new sampling programmes are the natural integrators. Results are kept available to the ARS, not transmitted, so there is no filing router to build. Sources: https://www.legifrance.gouv.fr/jorf/id/JORFTEXT000054321840 , https://www.aquaproxima.fr/piscines-fin-prelevements-ars-controle-exploitant/ , https://becarepool.com/ , https://poolog.fr/ , https://www.aquatycia.fr/carnet-sanitaire-piscine

name: Small-boat fishing e-reporting (1 July 2026 wave and 2028)
text: - **Small-boat fishing e-reporting (1 July 2026 wave and 2028):** FranceAgriMer's VISIOCaptures app is free. Source: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=fr.franceagrimer.visiocaptures , https://www.lofficieldesmetiers.fr/petite-peche-la-declaration-numerique-saccelere-au-1er-juillet/

name: Forex bureaux compliance
text: - **Forex bureaux compliance**: few operators, CBG-supervised, AML software is regional/global.

name: Small sewage plant maintenance protocols
text: - **Small sewage plant maintenance protocols:** a textbook "one job, several receiving bodies" case (municipality, lower water authority, sewage association). But U.A.N.'s DiWa5 already defines a nationwide interface, and LinWAS, DiWapp/homebook and Click+Clean (Börsch) build on it. https://www.uan.de/dienstleistungen/diwa-digitales-wartungsprotokoll ; https://www.linstep.de/instandhaltung-wartung-software/linwas-wartungssoftware-kleinklaeranlagen/

name: Livestock-trader control book and HI-Tier
text: - **Livestock-trader control book and HI-Tier:** Agrabiz plus the free HI-Tier portal. https://www.topagrar.com/perspektiven/digitalisierung/eine-app-fuer-den-viehhandel-12468276.html

name: Gun-dealer NWR reporting
text: - **Gun-dealer NWR reporting:** electronic by law since 2020; certified vendors. https://www.mtrlegal.com/wiki/nationales-waffenregister-nwr/

name: Pawnbrokers, hunters/game, coastal fishers (exempt below 15 m), chimney-sweep forms
text: - **Pawnbrokers, hunters/game, coastal fishers (exempt below 15 m), chimney-sweep forms:** too few buyers, hobby buyers, exempt, or already served.

name: Pre-trip inspection and trip-record logs for transport unions and bus companies (L.I. 2468)
text: Pre-trip inspection and trip-record logs for transport unions and bus companies (L.I. 2468) | NRSA's **TransportGhana** already offers e-manifest, departure control, e-tracking and e-driver-training monitoring.

name: Forex bureau AML/e-receipt compliance software
text: Forex bureau AML/e-receipt compliance software | BoG mandates its **centralised forex bureau platform** for all transactions.

name: Susu collector records
text: Susu collector records | Only ~472 licensed collectors. BoG digitisation guidelines unverified. Mobile-money susu apps likely exist.

name: Food-vendor health certificates, crèche registration, cattle movement permits
text: Food-vendor health certificates, crèche registration, cattle movement permits | Annual or per-event paperwork by individuals with no software budget. Assemblies and VSD run the counters.

name: Olive-mill compliance software
text: - **Olive-mill compliance software.** The workflow is real: digital delivery notes from grove to mill, purchase invoices to myDATA, and data feeding the growers' harvest declarations. But at least six Greek vendors already sell "myDATA / Olive Register-ready" mill software: Pegasus (TESAE / Z-net / Dual Logicom), Alpha Data, Amforeus (Nanosoft), aidpc, Zeyxis. Sources: https://www.tesae.gr/Elaiotriveio/Pegasus-ERP-Elaiotriveio, https://z-net.gr/elaiotriveio-erp-mydata-ready-einai-i-pleon-olokliromeni-lysi-tis-agoras/, https://nanosoft.gr/

name: Dairies (ELGO "ARTEMIS" milk declarations)
text: - **Dairies (ELGO "ARTEMIS" milk declarations).** Existing niche software and ERP coverage. https://anaptixioe.gr/

name: Quarries
text: - **Quarries:** 41 permits were withdrawn in March 2026 and the state is cleaning the cadastre (https://www.financialafrik.com/2026/03/11/guinee-letat-retire-41-permis-de-carrieres-pour-assainir-le-cadastre-minier-et-securiser-les-investissements). Titles are already covered by DAMANDA.

name: Domestic-worker employers, minibus operators, market vendors, rice millers
text: - **Domestic-worker employers, minibus operators, market vendors, rice millers:** none has a recurring multi-recipient filing, or the government is the only channel and buyers have low WTP. These verdicts come from desk judgement, not search evidence.

name: - Vatican "official operator" ticket reseller. Online competition exists, and th
text: - Vatican "official operator" ticket reseller. Online competition exists, and the access rules are unverified.

name: - All seed-list groups above. Each has no population in the territory, so the ve
text: - All seed-list groups above. Each has no population in the territory, so the verdict is structural, not competitive.

name: Household FDH employer payroll and contract tool
text: - **Household FDH employer payroll and contract tool:** about 360,000 helpers, but the buyer is a consumer household. Obligations are light (FDHs are exempt from MPF; there is one insurance policy and a two-year contract). DIY services such as daydayhelp, heyavo and gma.hk, plus agencies, already cover it. This idea depends on consumer behaviour.

name: Taxi e-payment and in-cab camera compliance
text: - **Taxi e-payment and in-cab camera compliance:** real mandates (e-payment from 1 Apr 2026, cameras by end-2026 linked to a government system), but they are met with hardware from designated suppliers and payment acquirers. There is no software wedge.

name: Pawnbrokers
text: - **Pawnbrokers:** a police-licensed, paper-heavy trade, but too few operators (count unverified) and likely covered by pawn POS software.

name: Money service operators
text: - **Money service operators:** premises fell from 2,017 (2019) to 817 (Jul 2025) (https://www.info.gov.hk/gia/general/202509/25/P2025092400905.htm). The trade is shrinking and AML/CDD software is a generic, crowded category.

name: Undertakers, livestock farms, animal traders and breeders
text: - **Undertakers, livestock farms, animal traders and breeders:** all have real registers and inspections, but too few operators: about 101 undertakers, 43 pig farms and about 117 AFCD trader and breeder licences (2017). Sources: https://www.info.gov.hk/gia/general/201105/25/P201105250206_print.htm, https://rr-asia.woah.org/app/uploads/2025/08/Hong-Kong-SAR_East-Asia-CVO-meeting_TADs_ASFother-diseases-1.pdf, https://www.info.gov.hk/gia/general/201707/12/P2017071200511p.htm

name: Livestock ENAR
text: - **Livestock ENAR:** WebENAR/WebTER plus the NÉBIH API, with farm software already connected. https://portal.nebih.gov.hu/documents/10182/1166164/ENAR+tajekoztato.pdf/6cb60efd-fb63-5f17-f5bb-076b6e6d6126

name: Contract distilleries
text: - **Contract distilleries:** an unproven lead rather than a rejection. There are about 900 distilleries and the NAV_J22 filing is electronic-only, but I found no evidence of the workflow pain or of Hungarian vendors. https://nav.gov.hu/nyomtatvanyok/letoltesek/nyomtatvanykitolto_programok/nyomtatvanykitolto_programok_nav/nav_j22

name: Childminder admin / supervision software
text: - **Childminder admin / supervision software.** About 75 childminders in Reykjavík. The state issues the permit and the municipality pays the subsidy. Too small.

name: Driving schools, fireworks retailers, arhtiyas
text: - **Driving schools, fireworks retailers, arhtiyas:** the govt portal already covers the flow (Sarathi, PESO, Mandi Board digital J-form), or there is no new trigger.

name: Private pawnshops (OJK)
text:
- **Private pawnshops (OJK).**
  - The trigger is real: POJK 39/2024, then POJK 29/2025 (effective 26 Nov 2025), offered regency/city-level pawnshops a simplified licence window from 1 Dec 2025 to 12 Jan 2026. OJK shut illegal pawnshops in 2026.
  - Killed by existing pawnshop software (SmartGadai; Starfield publishes buying guides for pawnshop software) and a pool of only ~214 licensed firms. OJK reporting goes through its own portals.
  - Sources: https://finansial.bisnis.com/read/20251116/89/1929171/pembiayaan-gadai-tembus-rp93-triliun-per-september-2025-didominasi-emas ; https://keuangan.kontan.co.id/news/ojk-sederhanakan-aturan-pergadaian-simak-rincian-ketentuan-terbarunya ; https://starfield.id/panduan-lengkap-memilih-software-pegadaian-terbaik-untuk-bisnis-anda/ ; https://finansial.bisnis.com/read/20260614/89/1980795/hati-hati-ada-184-perusahaan-gadai-belum-terdaftar-ojk

name: LPG 3 kg base sellers
text:
- **LPG 3 kg base sellers.** NIK recording is mandatory, but only in Pertamina's own free MAP app. There is nothing to integrate.
  - Source: https://industri.kontan.co.id/news/pertamina-catat-57-juta-nik-pembeli-lpg-3-kg-siap-jalankan-subsidi-tepat-sasaran

name: Inter-island cattle traders (NTT/NTB)
text:
- **Inter-island cattle traders (NTT/NTB).** Many documents are needed per shipment (health certificate, recommendations, veterinary certificate, quarantine). But the binding constraint is the governor's quota and its allocation. Ombudsman NTT calls it a "tangled thread", and Pergub 37/2025 is the legal basis. Software can't fix discretion.
  - Sources: https://ombudsman.go.id/news/download/pwkinternal--benang-kusut-pengeluaran-ternak-kabupaten-kupang ; https://ombudsman.go.id/news/download/pwkmedia--ombudsman-ntt-tegaskan-pergub-372025-jadi-payung-hukum-pengeluaran-ternak

name: Small-scale fishers (eLogbook/e-PIT)
text:
- **Small-scale fishers (eLogbook/e-PIT).** Free KKP apps with NGO activation drives. No willingness to pay.
  - Source: https://fisheryprogress.org/sites/default/files/documents_actions/12%20October%20-%20Socialisation%20and%20evaluation%20logbook%202023.pdf

name: Gold-dealer trade-registration tool
text: - **Gold-dealer trade-registration tool.** Real mandate, with a deadline, extensions and inspections reported in the press. Rejected because the buyer cannot be reached or paid from outside Iran, and a state-run portal plus domestic vendors fill the gap (unverified).

name: Ration agents (PDS)
text: - **Ration agents (PDS):** the Ministry of Trade's own "Wakeeli" agent app and the citizen ration-card app are the substitute. Source: https://www.almaali-iraq.com/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AA%D8%AC%D8%A7%D8%B1%D8%A9-40-%D9%85%D9%84%D9%8A%D9%88%D9%86-%D9%85%D8%B4%D9%85%D9%88%D9%84-%D8%A8%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A8%D8%B7%D8%A7%D9%82%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AA%D9%85%D9%88%D9%8A%D9%86/

name: Household-employer payroll (nannies, carers, auto-enrolment 2026)
text: - **Household-employer payroll (nannies, carers, auto-enrolment 2026):** NannyPayroll.ie and NannyPay already sell done-for-you payroll. Source: https://www.capterra.ie/reviews/31890/nannypay , https://www.hrheadquarters.ie/opinion/staff-advise-why-you-shouldnt-let-tax-worries-put-you-off-getting-childcare-at-home/

name: Fertiliser merchants' National Fertiliser Database returns
text: - **Fertiliser merchants' National Fertiliser Database returns:** the state offers an API and Herbst Software automates the upload. No new trigger. Source: https://www.herbstsoftware.com/introducing-the-national-fertiliser-database/ , https://assets.gov.ie/236512/8b5487f1-430d-451a-a0b6-86216e0feb34.pdf

name: Livestock dealers (934) and sheep dispatch dockets
text: - **Livestock dealers (934) and sheep dispatch dockets:** marts and AIM capture movements, and the free DAFM AIM Services app replaces posting dockets. Source: https://agriland.ie/farming-news/table-number-of-licenced-livestock-dealers-in-each-county , https://teagasc.ie/news--events/daily/new-app-aims-to-simplify-sheep-movements/

name: Household employers of foreign caregivers
text: - **Household employers of foreign caregivers.** The obligations are real and monthly (payslip, BTL 3.6% from Jan 2025, a 12.5% deposit), but the substitute is a done-for-you service: licensed caregiver agencies, Kav LaMaasik, payroll bureaus and accountants (about NIS 1,200/yr to maintain a withholding file). BTL also has its own household-employer payment screen. Households would not buy software. The country report already rejected this area.

name: Burial societies and cemeteries
text: - **Burial societies and cemeteries.** Served by Kanfey Sharet, UMP and the forum's GRAVEZ app.

name: Swimming pools
text: - **Swimming pools.** 1994 rules with no trigger. Dosing controllers and labs already cover the log.

name: Employers of Palestinian workers
text: - **Employers of Palestinian workers.** Market shrank in the war. Payroll bureaus already do it.

name: Compro oro
text: - **Compro oro:** at least 7 vertical vendors (Fixing, OroManager, OroGest, NvL, Fv ORO, Gestione Oro, software-compro-oro.it); the market shrank with the 2025 OPO register.

name: Beekeepers (BDN census), small-scale fishing (e-logbook), oil mills (SIAN), microbreweries (excise), market traders (annual attestation)
text: - **Beekeepers (BDN census), small-scale fishing (e-logbook), oil mills (SIAN), microbreweries (excise), market traders (annual attestation):** either annual and free with association help, or already served (TeamSystem Oil, the MASAF app).

name: Light-freight 業務記録 (2025-04)
text: - **Light-freight 業務記録 (2025-04):** not a quiet industry. CarryNote (¥800/month) and other 日報 and 点呼 apps already exist.

name: Individual-taxi records
text: - **Individual-taxi records:** 26,788 ageing operators, but their associations already do the admin and WTP is tiny.

name: Bounty claims for problem wildlife
text: - **Bounty claims for problem wildlife:** the municipality is the payer, which means procurement. Apps are being introduced.

name: Livestock tagging and traders
text: - **Livestock tagging and traders.** The MoA runs electronic chip tagging through field committees and the Sanad app, tied to the feed subsidy. The substitute is the government system itself, and herders have low willingness to pay.

name: Money changers
text: - **Money changers.** They are CBJ-supervised with established AML vendors, so they are not quiet.

name: Pawnshops (AFM reporting)
text: - **Pawnshops (AFM reporting):** too competitive (SmartLombard, PawnShop, 1C-Lombard). Sources: https://kz.kursiv.media/2026-01-05/fvfv-finmonitoring-usilivayut-afm-obnovilo-perechen-podozritelnyh-operaciy/, https://lombard.algo-rithm.com/lwchshie-programmy-dlya-lombarda-kazahstana/

name: Agrovet multi-regulator compliance (PCPB, KEPHIS, VMD, county)
text:
- **Agrovet multi-regulator compliance (PCPB, KEPHIS, VMD, county).**
  - The pattern is attractive: one shop answers several authorities, and the PCPB withdrawn/restricted list arrived in June 2025, followed by crackdowns in Aug–Sep 2026.
  - It was killed by very low willingness to pay and existing agrovet POS products (MTela, iPOS, agriPOS).
  - Enforcement targets counterfeit stock, not paperwork.
  - Possible later as a feature for a POS vendor.

name: Borehole and water permits
text: - **Borehole and water permits.** WRA's own app (Mar 2026) and smart-meter platform cover permits, payments and readings.

name: Matatu SACCOs
text: - **Matatu SACCOs.** Crowded field (SaccoWorks, MatatuOS, Simple Fare).

name: Fishers and BMUs
text: - **Fishers and BMUs.** Donor-funded state data systems already cover them.

name: Livestock holders
text:
- **Livestock holders.** PAAAF runs the holding plots, grazing licences and subsidised feed lists for free, through counters and the Meta app. The holders are subsidy-driven and willingness to pay is low.
  - https://www.alraimedia.com/article/1773791/
  - https://www.alanba.com.kw/1368251
  - https://www.aljarida.com/article/22264
  - https://www.aljarida.com/articles/1659812366752272700

name: Money exchangers
text: - **Money exchangers.** Not quiet; bank-grade vendors serve them.

name: Guesthouse foreigner registration
text: - **Guesthouse foreigner registration:** the state ESUVM portal and mobile app already do this. (https://www.currenttime.tv/a/33849992.html)

name: Scrap metal register or software
text: - **Scrap metal register or software:** the market is consolidated. TOLMETS owns about half of the reception sites, and the number of firms halved in 10 years (Competition Council 2025: https://kp.gov.lv/lv/media/13658/download?attachment=). Licensing rules: https://likumi.lv/ta/id/241854

name: EUDR for forest owners and small sawmills
text: - **EUDR for forest owners and small sawmills:** Latvia is classed low risk, and micro firms have simplified duties from June 2027. The statement goes into TRACES with VMD support. Buyers absorb the work, and local vendors exist (https://www.zm.gov.lv/lv/es-atmezosanas-regula-eudr, https://vandretdigital.eu/par-eudr).

name: Cemeteries
text: - **Cemeteries:** Cemety.lv is the incumbent, and the buyers are municipalities (https://www.apollo.lv/7061539/latvija-digitalizets-jau-miljons-apbedijuma-vietu).

name: Livestock register / mark-tracking app for farmers or traders
text: - **Livestock register / mark-tracking app for farmers or traders.** Farmers cannot register without the ministry issuing the mark, and the National Livestock Register belongs to the state. The substitutes are LRMIS, chiefs' letters and police stock-theft units.

name: Domestic-worker payslip / contract tool
text: - **Domestic-worker payslip / contract tool.** There is a minimum-wage notice but no registration or filing obligation, and wages are too low for an employer to pay for software.

name: Burial-society administration
text: - **Burial-society administration.** Insurers and the telco (EcoSure via EcoCash, application forms at ETL shops) already provide collection and administration free to the society.

name: Diamond dealers' export documentation
text: - **Diamond dealers' export documentation:** MCAS issues QR-coded export documents at the valuation desk, so the government system already does the job.

name: Chimney-sweep inspection records
text: - **Chimney-sweep inspection records.** Only a handful of district-appointed sweeps exist (Kaminfegerverordnung 1975, https://www.gesetze.li/chrono/pdf/1975063000), and Swiss trade software covers them.

name: Cemetery and funeral records
text: - **Cemetery and funeral records:** CEMETY already serves 54 of 60 municipalities; buyers are municipalities (procurement) and funeral firms are tiny (229 firms, about 1,200 staff).

name: Money-changer KYC/AML
text: - **Money-changer KYC/AML.** There are dozens of operators supervised by AMCM. Existing AML vendors and bank or casino group tools cover them.

name: Zebu FIB / cattle-trade paperwork
text:
- **Zebu FIB / cattle-trade paperwork.**
  - Décret 2017-023 makes the FIB mandatory for every bovine, plus permits for movement and sale. The STIB electronic ear-tag pilot started in 2021, and a February 2026 Ministry of Livestock document and a June 2026 digital agriculture infrastructure event show the state digitising this itself.
  - The BIANCO (anti-corruption bureau) reports that the pain is informal payments at every step. Software cannot fix that.
  - The payers are smallholders.
  - Sources: https://textes.lexxika.com/lois-malagasy/decret-n2017-023-du-10-janvier-2017-relatif-au-recensement-a-lidentification-a-la-circulation-et-a-la-commercialisation-des-bovins/, https://bianco-mg.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/10/SYNTHESE-RAPPORT-ACW-FIB_-DT-Toliara.pdf, https://www.ifc.org/fr/stories/2022/un-systeme-de-marquage-moderne-pour-proteger-une-race-bovine-ancienne-a-madagascar, https://cgspace.cgiar.org/server/api/core/bitstreams/ea143266-eb64-4ba1-986b-01e8fdbd9a8b/content

name: Livestock movement permits
text: - **Livestock movement permits.** These are paper permits issued by district veterinary officers. They are low value and nobody would pay for software.

name: Private schools (ISAMA, 2,000+ members)
text: - **Private schools (ISAMA, 2,000+ members).** The recurring work is generic school administration, which is crowded. MANEB has already digitised fee payment.

name: Money changers
text: - **Money changers:** heavily supervised, likely already served by vendors.

name: Taxi / dhoni / vessel licensing
text: - **Taxi / dhoni / vessel licensing:** renewals are periodic counter visits with no recurring report. Dispatch apps and the counter are the substitutes.

name: Dive centres
text: - **Dive centres:** mature international dive-shop software, and no new trigger.

name: Livestock export certificates
text: - **Livestock export certificates:** the certificate is issued per shipment by state vets. The trader's cost is a fee plus a broker, not something software replaces. Export corridors are disrupted (blockade, AES/ECOWAS split).

name: Hunters' bag returns
text: - **Hunters' bag returns:** the regulator already offers a phone and mobile-app reporting system (https://wbru.gov.mt/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/Game-Reporting-Data-report-2025.pdf). The group is also politically toxic.
