name: Copra collection and purchase records (Tobolar quarterly cycle)
text: - **Copra collection and purchase records (Tobolar quarterly cycle).** There is a real 2023 legal trigger, but there is one buyer, Tobolar, which is a state authority. Any digitisation goes through Tobolar or donor procurement, not indie SaaS.

name: MISSA quarterly return helper for small and household employers
text: - **MISSA quarterly return helper for small and household employers.** The obligation is real and quarterly, but there are only a few hundred employers. Bookkeepers already do it, so it is an add-on at best (see the tax add-on in the country report, scored 2/10).

name: Household-employer contribution filing
text: - **Household-employer contribution filing.** The substitute is the MRA's free MRAeasy app, which covers both filing and payment. The remaining payslip and leave work is too small to sell.

name: Domestic-worker employers (IMSS)
text: 1. **Domestic-worker employers (IMSS).** Mandatory since 2023, but only 59–61k of ~2.5M workers are registered [V]. The substitutes are the free IMSS portal, free calculators (ilovecfdi) and **Symplifica**, a Colombian app live in Mexico covering registration, contracts and monthly payroll [V]. Weak enforcement means households don't pay.

name: Pawnbrokers
text: 3. **Pawnbrokers.** 4,042 PROFECO-registered shops [V]. The obligation is an annual renewal, the AML side is crowded (see country report), and pawn POS software exists [BK].

name: Pest control (NOM-256)
text: 5. **Pest control (NOM-256).** A per-service certificate is mandatory [V], but the trade is not quiet and generic field-service apps cover it [BK].

name: Excise / small-winery traceability
text: - **Excise / small-winery traceability:** state-procured system and enterprise vendors (from the country report).

name: Household payroll SaaS on its own
text: - **Household payroll SaaS on its own.** The CSM's free tele-service already calculates payslips and takes declarations.

name: Soum private veterinary units
text:
- **Soum private veterinary units.** About 744–800 units. Reporting goes into the government MAHIS, the state is the payer and the units have thin margins. Substitute: MAHIS plus donor-funded EWAR manuals.
  - Sources: https://rr-asia.woah.org/app/uploads/2021/07/08_mongolia_fmd_ppp_nvs_private_vet_sector.pdf, https://rr-asia.woah.org/app/uploads/2025/05/5.5-GERELMAA20250513_Mongolia-FMD-surveillance.pdf

name: Livestock traders and herders
text:
- **Livestock traders and herders.** The census and animal ID are run by the state and donors, and herders do not buy software.
  - Sources: https://www.nampa.org/text/22818681, https://akipress.com/news:600411/

name: Gold and precious-metal dealers
text:
- **Gold and precious-metal dealers.** FIU forms already cover the reporting, there are few dealers, and Mongolbank is the dominant buyer.
  - Source: https://fiu.mongolbank.mn/file/files/documents/cma/guide20201029.pdf

name: Taxi and market traders
text: - **Taxi and market traders:** the obligations (fiscalization) are already covered by POS vendors.

name: Taxi licence holders
text: - **Taxi licence holders:** the reform is still a study. The proposals include a state "national unified app", and the ministry denied a rumoured July 2026 rule. Sources: [Médias24](https://medias24.com/2025/12/22/laftit-le-taxi-doit-se-moderniser-pour-survivre-face-aux-bus-et-au-numerique-1601027/), [Médias24 denial](https://medias24.com/2026/04/09/le-ministere-de-linterieur-dement-la-publication-dun-communique-sur-la-gestion-et-lexploitation-des-agrements-de-taxis-1657094/).

name: Moto-taxi / app transport licensing
text: - **Moto-taxi / app transport licensing.** Matola licenses through the Yango platform, which acts as the substitute channel. Source: https://aimnews.org/2025/09/03/yango-e-municipio-da-matola-lancam-solucoes-inovadoras-para-mobilidade-urbana/

name: Small-employer INSS contributions
text: - **Small-employer INSS contributions.** Real non-compliance (only 45–50% of ~200k firms pay regularly), but payroll vendors already cover it (see the main report).

name: Gold dealers
text: - **Gold dealers:** compliance means following the reference price, which is enforced by arresting association leaders (Feb 2026). Software can't help, and the legal and reputational exposure is high.

name: FNMIS check-in helper for small guesthouses and homestays
text:
- **FNMIS check-in helper for small guesthouses and homestays:**
  - The trigger is real: FNMIS is mandatory for all hotels and guesthouses nationwide from March 2026, and only about 1,600 providers had enrolled by May 2026.
  - It was killed because the government portal and QR scan are free and quick.
  - The real barrier is connectivity and enforcement, not missing software, and a hotel PMS would absorb any integration.
  - Sources: https://himalpress.com/2026/05/over-100000-foreign-nationals-tracked-in-five-months/ , https://www.thirdrockadventures.com/travel-news/nepal-tightens-oversight-as-digital-system-tracks-foreign-visitors

name: Tourist tax and night register for B&Bs and small campsites
text: - **Tourist tax and night register for B&Bs and small campsites.** The substitutes are free Excel and Samsom paper registers from municipalities, and vacation-rental software that calculates the tax (Smoobu). The return is annual or quarterly and the value is low.

name: Cemeteries
text: - **Cemeteries.** Eight or more vendors plus the KKA admin service; no new trigger.

name: Beekeepers
text: - **Beekeepers:** HiveHub (official and free) already covers ADRs, apiary registration and AFB reports. 8,218 beekeepers, and the number is falling about 10% a year.

name: Money changers, moto-taxis, gold buyers
text: - **Money changers, moto-taxis, gold buyers:** informal or politically sensitive, with no software buyer.

name: PPMVs
text: - **PPMVs.** Annual PCN licence, very low willingness to pay. Source: https://pcn.gov.ng/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/PCN-Review-PPMVL-Guidelines-for-the-Issuance-of-Patent-and-Proprietary-Medicines-Vendors-Licence.pdf

name: Mineral buying centres
text: - **Mineral buying centres.** The value-addition rules are a capital problem, not a software one. Source: https://www.ajot.com/news/nigeria-seeks-to-tighten-rules-to-curb-raw-mineral-exports

name: Taxi trip and meter rules (watch)
text: - **Taxi trip and meter rules (watch).** Consultation due in autumn 2026. Centrals and taximeter vendors will absorb the work. Source: https://stortinget.no/globalassets/pdf/innstillinger/stortinget/2025-2026/inns-202526-305l.pdf

name: Street taxis
text: - **Street taxis.** The regulator already forced them onto licensed metering apps.

name: Sanad centres as buyers
text: - **Sanad centres as buyers.** They are the paid intermediary and run on government portals. They are a channel, not a software buyer.

name: Second-hand mobile phone registers
text:
- **Second-hand mobile phone registers.** Punjab's free eGadget app (PITB with the police) is the
  register; other cities use a paper pro forma for police. No willingness to pay.

name: Tenant registration for landlords and property dealers
text:
- **Tenant registration for landlords and property dealers.** Free police portal, Khidmat Markaz
  and app; a one-time event per tenancy.

name: Retail medical stores (scheduled-drug register)
text:
- **Retail medical stores (scheduled-drug register).** Pharmacy POS is crowded; the DRAP T&T angle
  is already in the country report.

name: Money-changer AML compliance
text: - **Money-changer AML compliance:** PMA-supervised and bank-adjacent. It needs a local licence-aware vendor and carries sanctions exposure (Decree-Law 40/2022; PMA AML instructions).

name: Taxi offices under the 2025 app regulation
text: - **Taxi offices under the 2025 app regulation:** this creates demand for dispatch apps (generic ride-hail), not for compliance.

name: Domestic-worker employer payroll
text:
- **Domestic-worker employer payroll.** SIPE is free and covers domestic employers. The problem is non-registration (87% reportedly uninsured), and software does not fix that. Households will not pay.
  - Sources: https://www.telemetro.com/nacionales/sipe-la-css-que-es-y-quienes-lo-utilizan-la-caja-seguro-social-n5997013 , https://panamaamerica.com.pa/nacion/el-87-de-las-domesticas-no-tienen-seguridad-social-806011

name: Pawnshop compliance
text:
- **Pawnshop compliance.** The MICI licence (Ley 16/2005, DE 65/2006) is a one-off counter procedure. No new trigger was found, and loan software exists (**unverified**).
  - Sources: https://mici.gob.pa/wp-content/uploads/2022/04/GUIA-NO.-2-REQUISITOS-DE-CASA-EMPENO-1.pdf , https://www.panamadigital.gob.pa/informaciontramite/solicitud-de-casa-de-empeno

name: Taxi operators
text:
- **Taxi operators.** ATTT is building its own official trip and fare app (Dec 2026), which is voluntary. Owners have no recurring filing.
  - Sources: https://www.laestrella.com.pa/panama/nacional/attt-impondra-taximetro-digital-en-panama-en-diciembre-BP23974252 , https://www.laestrella.com.pa/panama/nacional/attt-avala-plataforma-digital-para-taxis-con-pagos-electronicos-y-trazabilidad-MA24066846

name: Coffee/cocoa dealer licensing (CIC, Cocoa Board)
text: - **Coffee/cocoa dealer licensing (CIC, Cocoa Board):** these are real licensed registers with paper-based quality control (CIC revised its green-bean standards and regulation guidelines with PHAMA Plus). But the exporter count is small, and EUDR traceability, the only frequent workflow, is already covered in the country report and by buyer-funded tools. Sources: [PHAMA Plus – New standards to improve PNG's coffee trade](https://phamaplus.com.au/?p=14358), [EMTV – Quality of export beans](https://emtv.com.pg/quality-of-export-beans-crucial-for-coffee-industry).

name: PMV operators, market and betel-nut vendors, household employers
text: - **PMV operators, market and betel-nut vendors, household employers:** these are cash-based and informal, with no willingness to pay for software and no enforced recurring filing.

name: Rice mill Registro IVAP
text:
- **Rice mill Registro IVAP.**
  - Mandatory, notary-legalised, and no more than 10 days late. Local vertical software already exists (Tecnocomp Sistema para Molinos) and there is no new trigger.
  - Sources: https://orientacion.sunat.gob.pe/06-registro-ivap-para-propietarios-del-molino-yo-que-presta-servicios-de-pilado , https://www.tecnocomp.com.pe/sistemas/molinos/

name: LPG retailer DOE compliance (RA 11592)
text: - **LPG retailer DOE compliance (RA 11592).** Annual reportorial forms and a one-off LTO. Consultants (Triple i) already sell it.

name: Transport cooperatives (CDA/OTC)
text: - **Transport cooperatives (CDA/OTC).** Annual reports handled by co-op accountants. Modernized fleets already have AFCS and GPS vendors.

name: Septic-hauler quarterly municipal reports
text: - **Septic-hauler quarterly municipal reports.** This is the closest Polish analogue to the Florida grease benchmark: one job, many municipalities, quarterly. It is already covered by Aquarius GO (free for haulers), Asenizacja.online, BioKontrol and the free Monitoring Ścieki Polskie for municipalities. Sources: https://e-awos.pl/aquarius-go/, https://asenizacja.online/faq/, https://audit-grc.pl/biokontrol/oprogramowanie-do-gospodarki-sciekowej/, https://www.biznes.gov.pl/pl/opisy-procedur/-/proc/371

name: Livestock traders and IRZplus
text: - **Livestock traders and IRZplus.** IRZplus.pl and Byczkomat.pl already offer ARiMR API submission with OCR.

name: Driving-school digital trainee card (UD402)
text: - **Driving-school digital trainee card (UD402).** A big new obligation, but at least 5 vendors are already "ready", the law is still a draft, and the trade body TLP opposes the cost. Sources: https://www.gazetaprawna.pl/wiadomosci/kraj/artykuly/11269603,prawo-jazdy-2027-koniec-placu-manewrowego-nowe-egzaminy-i-cyfrowa-karta-kursanta.html, https://oskadmin.pl/funkcje/cyfrowa-karta-kursanta, https://cardrivemanager.com/start/blog/cyfrowa-karta-kursanta-my-juz-jestesmy-gotowi/2

name: Care agencies and A1 postings
text: - **Care agencies and A1 postings.** HRappka, Hrily, SilverGo and Lockstep already serve them.

name: Scrap yards
text: - **Scrap yards.** itopen.pl plus BDO vendors.

name: Hunting clubs
text: - **Hunting clubs.** Already about 80% electronic, with many vendors.

name: Tattoo studios, plant nurseries, well drillers
text: - **Tattoo studios, plant nurseries, well drillers.** No recurring filing worth software.

name: - Driving schools: software already sold (AutoviaTest); Decreto-Lei 112/2026 red
text: - Driving schools: software already sold (AutoviaTest); Decreto-Lei 112/2026 reduces school work. https://autoviatest.com/pt-PT/for-schools

name: - Small-boat fishermen: electronic reporting for all vessels from 2028 is an EU
text: - Small-boat fishermen: electronic reporting for all vessels from 2028 is an EU rule, but owners are unlikely to pay and the state will probably supply the app (unverified); exact small-boat date not confirmed.

name: Bureaux de change
text: - **Bureaux de change:** these are licensed one at a time by arrêté (e.g. Arrêté 1174/2025, San Money) under CEMAC Regulation 02/18. There are probably only tens of them, and they report to BEAC, which is closed to outside vendors. Sources: https://www.sgg.cg/textes-officiels/arretes/2025/congo-arrete-2025-1174.pdf, https://kalieu-elongo.com/reglementation-des-bureaux-de-change-en-zone-cemac-ce-quil-faut-savoir/

name: Urban minibuses
text: - **Urban minibuses:** the state passcard already covers e-payment, and operators are informal. Source: https://cio-mag.com/?p=19380

name: Day-labourer register helper
text: **Day-labourer register helper** | The free state app (Inspecția Muncii) already does CSV import and ID scanning. ITM fines (over 1M lei in summer 2025) push farms to the app, not to a third party

name: Pawnshop AML/KYC
text: **Pawnshop AML/KYC** | The sector is dominated by chains. ONPCSB's own portal handles reports. No new trigger was found. Software is likely already in place (unverified)

name: Taxi
text: **Taxi** | Dispatch software and ride-hailing apps

name: Apiary registration and hive tagging (Horriot)
text: - **Apiary registration and hive tagging (Horriot):** a real 2025 trigger, but the district vet station does the registration, and the remaining task (printing hive tags) is a stationery product, not software.

name: - Street vendors: subsidised, low income
text: - Street vendors: subsidised, low income.

name: Minibus and taxi licence-renewal tracker
text:
- **Minibus and taxi licence-renewal tracker.** This is an annual renewal keyed to the plate's last digit. The IRD already runs a vehicle-licence e-service page. A tracker would be a reminder app at best.
  Sources: https://www.sknird.com/vehicle-licence/, https://eservicesskn.sknird.com/VehicleLic-Page.aspx?PageID=61

name: Street and food vendors' permit bundle
text:
- **Street and food vendors' permit bundle.** A vendor needs several permits: a business licence, Ministry of Finance street-vending authorisation, a food handler's permit, and an Environmental Health site approval. That makes it a multi-authority workflow, and enforcement resumed in Feb 2026. But the renewals are annual, the vendors are informal, and the pool is tiny. At most it would be a service that a local business-registration agent could offer.
  Sources: https://sknis.gov.kn/2021/07/24/street-vending-in-st-kitts-and-nevis-is-governed-by-several-key-pieces-of-legislation-says-mr-farier/, https://skncgtoronto.gov.kn/?p=14452, https://skncgtoronto.gov.kn/?p=14650

name: Castries vendor registration
text: - **Castries vendor registration:** the council provides IDs and benefits, and vendors would not pay. Sources: https://thevoiceslu.com/2024/11/ccc-tackles-overcrowding-of-vendors-in-city-centre/ , https://thevoiceslu.com/2020/07/market-vendors-urged-to-keep-standards-high/

name: Butchers / meat inspection
text:
- **Butchers / meat inspection:** the inspection is booked by phone and the Environmental Health
  Officer issues the certificate. The butcher does no filing that software would replace.
  Sources: https://health.gov.vc/health/index.php/news/1212-public-health-department-meat-inspection ,
  https://onenewsstvincent.com/2022/12/21/butchers-must-contact-public-health-department-before-selling-meat

name: Kingstown vendors
text:
- **Kingstown vendors:** EC$5/day paid in cash at the Town Board, about 90 permitted vendors,
  and a 2026 crackdown on illegal vending. There is no software buyer. Sources:
  https://www.searchlight.vc/front-page/2024/01/19/vendors-told-pay-due-fees-go ,
  https://onenewsstvincent.com/2026/02/17/government-signals-tougher-stance-on-street-vending-in-kingstown
---

name: Organic and small food producers
text: - **Organic and small food producers:** the certifier, Italian HACCP consultants and generic apps cover this.

name: Moto-taxi, market-vendor and scrap registers
text: - **Moto-taxi, market-vendor and scrap registers.** No traceable recurring filing was found online. They are informal and the districts collect in cash.

name: Household employers / Musaned wage protection
text: - **Household employers / Musaned wage protection**: buyers are consumers, and Musaned plus bank and wallet transfers already serve the mandate (https://holool2030.com/?p=6030 ; https://www.hrsd.gov.sa/ar/media-center/news/130520241).

name: Gold and jewellery shop AML/KYC
text: - **Gold and jewellery shop AML/KYC**: Daftra (https://www.daftra.com/%D8%A8%D8%B1%D9%86%D8%A7%D9%85%D8%AC-%D8%A5%D8%AF%D8%A7%D8%B1%D8%A9-%D9%85%D8%AD%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B0%D9%87%D8%A8-%D9%88%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D8%AC%D9%88%D9%87%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%AA) and DEXEF (https://dexef.com/apps/gold-store-accounts-software) already cover gold POS with ZATCA. The AML add-on is a feature, not a product. Background: https://mc.gov.sa/ar/mediacenter/News/Pages/04-01-21-01.aspx ; https://www.aleqt.com/2021/10/11/article_2187756.html

name: Recruitment offices
text: - **Recruitment offices**: they work inside Musaned. Enforcement is real (https://sabq.org/article/EuXiWBL ; https://www.okaz.com.sa/local/na/2244984), but the incumbent is the government platform. Not pursued.

name: Veterinary pharmacies
text: - **Veterinary pharmacies:** a small market with no new reporting. Sources: https://rr-africa.woah.org/app/uploads/2025/01/4.1.Senegal.pdf, https://www.ampeid.org/static/91489a28f677af0fbc9d1dd4af44f819/Senegal_VetPharmacy..pdf

name: Currency exchangers
text: - **Currency exchangers:** the amended Foreign Exchange Law (in force 14 Mar 2025) brings strong enforcement, but exchangers must use NBS software or a bank's software, so no third-party software slot exists. Sources: https://www.paragraf.rs/dnevne-vesti/210325/210325-vest6.html , https://n1info.rs/biznis/nbs-zatvorila-90-menjacnica-na-mesec-dana-zbog-nepravilnosti-u-radu/

name: Seasonal workers
text: - **Seasonal workers:** the free state portal and app already handle it (sezonskiradnici.gov.rs). Revisit only if the scheme is extended to household help, tourism or construction. Sources: https://naled.rs/htdocs/Files/02013/Vodic-za-sezonce.pdf , https://www.politika.rs/sr/clanak/500275/Angazovanje-sezonskih-radnika-siri-se-i-na-druge-oblasti , https://pitajknjigovodju.rs/sezonski-poslovi-u-poljoprivredi-ovo-su-obaveze-poslodavaca-i-prava-radnika/

name: Scrap buyers
text: - **Scrap buyers:** covered by the waste-software vendors in the country report, plus accountants for the withholding tax.

name: Taxi/minibus operator compliance
text: - **Taxi/minibus operator compliance.** The only recurring touchpoint found is licensing, and the operator base is small. There is an association channel (STOA), but nothing for software to do. Sources: [nation.sc 2021](https://nation.sc/articles/10342/adverts), [nation.sc 2021](https://nation.sc/articles/8557/adverts), [SeyLII SI 16/2015](https://seylii.org/akn/sc/act/si/2015/16).

name: NASSIT informal-sector scheme
text: - **NASSIT informal-sector scheme:** voluntary contributions on NASSIT-run rails; watch it, but there is no software buyer. Sources: https://awokonewspapersl.com/?p=155688 ; https://www.premiermedia-sl.com/?p=28290

name: Gold/diamond dealer ledgers
text: - **Gold/diamond dealer ledgers:** already covered in the first-round report; MCAS is the substitute.

name: Money changers
text: - **Money changers:** about 231 licences (2022); MAS-supervised AML is already targeted by vendors such as Biz4x and by consultants.

name: Hunting-ground records under the draft new hunting act
text:
- **Hunting-ground records under the draft new hunting act.** SPK's free DoReviru.sk and two other apps already cover them.
  - Sources:
    - https://polovnickakomora.sk/sk/3399-spk-ponuka-vlastnu-elektronicku-knihu-navstev-polovneho-reviru.html
    - https://hsr.rokovania.sk/data/att/186771_subor.pdf

name: Pesticide-use records (EU 2023/564)
text:
- **Pesticide-use records (EU 2023/564).** Substitutes are ÚKSÚP's free IS CÚR form and farm software.
  - Sources:
    - https://www.uksup.sk/storage/app/media/Navody_CUR/Manu%C3%A1l%20pre%20Elektronick%C3%BA%20evidenciu%20spotreby%20POR%20a%20hnoj%C3%ADv.pdf
    - https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg_impl/2023/564/oj?locale=sk

name: Wine reports
text:
- **Wine reports.** Annual reports go into the free IS CÚR. The cellar book is a possible niche, but a Czech competitor is likely (unverified).
  - Sources:
    - https://www.uksup.sk/sk/aktualita/402/hlasenie-o-hrozne-vine-a-muste-do-10122024
    - https://www.uksup.sk/vinar

name: Cemetery grave registers
text:
- **Cemetery grave registers.** The cintoriny.sk mapping service already sells this to municipalities, with contracts in the public contract register (CRZ).
  - Source: https://www.crz.gov.sk//data/att/4865967.pdf

name: Scrap-metal purchase records
text:
- **Scrap-metal purchase records.** The rule dates from 2016, so there is no trigger. It overlaps with ISOH waste software.
  - Sources:
    - https://static.slov-lex.sk/static/SK/ZZ/2015/79/20170501.html
    - https://www.odpadovyhospodar.sk/hovori-sa-ze-od-1-januara-uz-za-kovovy-odpad-v-zberni-nedostanete-peniaze-v-hotovosti-my-tvrdime-opak/

name: Slovak 24-hour caregivers in Austria
text:
- **Slovak 24-hour caregivers in Austria.** Done-for-you tax and A1 services already exist, and the regime is Austrian. Software for placement agencies was not verified.
  - Sources:
    - https://www.opatrovanie-rakusko.sk/opatrovanie-rakusko/21-Formulare-E106-a-E101
    - https://agenturamatlovicova.sk/rakuske-danove-priznanie-pre-opatrovatelky/
    - https://www.sav.sk/news/8040

name: Chimney-sweep service records (EviDim)
text: - **Chimney-sweep service records (EviDim):** About 149 licensed companies (2021). EviDim already has SOAP web services. Dovrtel sistemi sells software for chimney-sweep companies. The emission measurements, which would have been the trigger, were postponed again by about 3 years (Uredba consolidated text of 16 Jun 2026, STA). Sources: https://www.gov.si/assets/ministrstva/MOPE/Okolje/Dimnikarska-dejavnost/Evidim_predstavitev_24okt17.pdf, https://www.dovrtel-sistemi.si/dimnikarska-dejavnost/dimnikarska-druzba, https://www.tax-fin-lex.si/home/novica/36219, https://www.gov.si/novice/2022-03-14-nadzor-dimnikarskih-druzb-dimnikarjev-dimnikarskih-storitev-in-njihovih-uporabnikov-v-letu-2021/

name: Water safety plans for small and village water supplies
text: - **Water safety plans for small and village water supplies:** The duty is real (Uredba o pitni vodi 2023) and the pain is documented. But the buyers are unfunded village committees, and the work is consultancy, not software. Sources: https://www.uradni-list.si/glasilo-uradni-list-rs/vsebina/2023-01-1848/uredba-o-pitni-vodi, https://nijz.si/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/Dostop-do-PV-in-njena-kakovost-v-Sloveniji-za-leto-2024.pdf, https://podcrto.si/nevarna-voda-kateri-vodovodi-ogrozajo-zdravje-ljudi-in-zakaj/, https://forum-media.si/izdelek/varnostni-nacrt-za-pitno-vodo/

name: Beekeeper colony reporting
text: - **Beekeeper colony reporting:** The free Register čebelnjakov app covers it, with a no-login form. Source: https://www.gov.si/zbirke/storitve/sporocanje-stevila-cebeljih-druzin-v-register-cebelnjakov-in-podatkov-v-register-zivilskih-obratov

name: Market-vendor fee management
text: - **Market-vendor fee management:** HCC collects cash daily at the market. Vendors have no record-keeping duty and no money to pay. Source: https://www.sibconline.com.sb/?p=10286

name: Hawala / money-transfer AML reporting
text:
- **Hawala / money-transfer AML reporting:**
  - Only seven licensed money-transfer businesses, all large (Dahabshil, Salaam, Amal and others).
  - They use in-house systems and enterprise AML vendors.
  - Not a quiet industry.
  - Sources: sominvest.gov.so; CBS registration and licensing regulations.

name: Domestic-worker payroll, UIF and COIDA
text:
- **Domestic-worker payroll, UIF and COIDA.** A real obligation (COIDA registration within 7 days, ROE by 30 Jun 2026), but **AskMandla** (R49/month plus R450 setup, WhatsApp-based) and **MyHelper** (Sep 2025, automated Department of Labour submissions) already serve it, plus at least 4 payroll sites.
  - https://www.sowetan.co.za/consumer/2026-07-20-whatsapp-based-service-helps-manage-domestic-workers-lawfully/
  - https://briefly.co.za/people/247694-entrepreneurs-myhelper-platform-paying-domestic-workers-easier-south-africans/
  - https://serr.co.za/compensation-fund-what-every-employer-of-domestic-workers-needs-to-know

name: ECD subsidy claims
text:
- **ECD subsidy claims.** Pain comes from late payment (KZN High Court) and budget cuts, not paperwork. **Grow Educare's** app is free and already does attendance registers.
  - https://www.dailymaverick.co.za/article/2026-04-08-kzn-education-departments-failure-to-pay-ecd-subsidies-on-time-is-exacerbating-nutrition-challenges/
  - https://ilifalabantwana.co.za/news/2026-budget-cuts-r800-million-from-ecd-subsidies/
  - https://citizen.co.za/berea-mail/?p=307768

name: LPG gas CoCs
text: - **LPG gas CoCs.** SAQCC Gas already replaced paper CoCs with its own app.

name: Burial societies and funeral parlours
text: - **Burial societies and funeral parlours.** Insurance-law complexity and existing admin software.

name: Pest control operators
text: - **Pest control operators.** No trigger and mature SaaS.

name: Fishing-charter passenger rosters (낚시어선 승선자명부)
text: - **Fishing-charter passenger rosters (낚시어선 승선자명부):** this is the strongest *offline evidence* in Korea. 87.1% of rosters are still photos of paper lists and only 1.6% are e-filed (Aug 2026). But the coast guard's free QR app 낚시해 exists, and the government is connecting it to the booking platforms 물반고기반 and 더피싱. Captains won't pay to fix a free government process. Sources: http://www.haesanews.com/news/articleView.html?idxno=151515 ; https://edaily.co.kr/News/Read?mediaCodeNo=257&newsId=02351766625935544 ; https://www.hkbs.co.kr/news/articleView.html?idxno=646937 ; https://news.nate.com/view/20260929n21588

name: Butcher traceability ledgers
text: - **Butcher traceability ledgers:** the mtrace system counts as the ledger, and the 이력스캔 app auto-generates the report forms. Sources: http://mtrace.go.kr/pdf/beef_traceability_distribution_manuList.pdf ; https://apps.apple.com/us/app/id6468613693

name: Butchers and market-trader charge ledgers
text: - **Butchers and market-trader charge ledgers:** the pain is overlapping and extra-legal collection by several bodies. That is a political problem, not a software one. Sources: [Eye Radio: Butchers Union threatens strike](https://www.eyeradio.org/butchers-union-threatens-to-strike-as-govt-unwilling-to-address-land-taxation-concerns/), [Eye Radio: Juba traders blame multiple charges](https://www.eyeradio.org/juba-traders-blame-multiple-charges-for-price-hikes-chamber-of-commerce-foresees-relief/), [VOA: Illegal checkpoints](https://voaafrica.com/a/6972628.html).

name: Household employers / domestic workers under NSIF
text: - **Household employers / domestic workers under NSIF:** households will not register or pay for software.

name: Gold buyers and jewellers (police book, 115B, AML)
text: - **Gold buyers and jewellers (police book, 115B, AML):** ORONET by DigiNet is an entrenched vertical vendor.

name: Hunting estates
text: - **Hunting estates:** regions give away digital-tag apps (Andalusia, CLM, CyL, Aragón). The catch report is annual.

name: Small-scale fishing e-logbook
text: - **Small-scale fishing e-logbook:** state apps, plus cofradía and fish-market vendors (GrupoCIE, Sinerxia).

name: Three-wheelers
text: - **Three-wheelers:** meter rules are poorly enforced, and ride-hailing apps already cover the digitised segment.

name: Gum arabic traceability
text: - **Gum arabic traceability:** the chain is opaque because armed groups control it, not because the paperwork is badly tooled. A software fix doesn't apply.

name: Shop cash-register mandate (2026)
text: - **Shop cash-register mandate (2026):** cheap cash registers cost US$100–150, and this is already covered by the BTW idea in the country report. Source: https://www.srherald.com/suriname/2026/03/08/regering-wil-kassasystemen-verplicht-stellen-voor-btw-controle/

name: Farm-gate alcohol kit (was 3/10 in the interrupted draft, now rejected)
text: - **Farm-gate alcohol kit (was 3/10 in the interrupted draft, now rejected):** only 178 permits by 30 Apr 2026 and 188 by 15 Jun 2026, which is below the 300 kill threshold. Spiris (Visma) already publishes guidance aimed at these firms. https://www.can.se/app/uploads/2026/04/kortfakta-09-gardsforsaljning-i-sverige-vem-ar-koparen.pdf ; https://www.spiris.se/blogg/lagar-regler/gardsforsaljning ; https://accentmagasin.se/alkohol/forsta-sommaren-med-gardsforsaljning-fa-tillstand-har-delats-ut/

name: Weapons-dealer transaction reporting
text: - **Weapons-dealer transaction reporting.** The paper Waffenhandelsbuch ended on 31 Dec 2021. About 250 retailers report electronically through Guichet Unique (Bedag), and dealer software exists (comp-sys). Sources: https://www.bedag.ch/de/aktuelles/meldungen/Guichet-Unique-nationale-Meldeplattform-fuer-Waffentransaktionen.php, https://comp-sys.ch/waffenhaendler/

name: Livestock-trader accompanying documents and TVD
text: - **Livestock-trader accompanying documents and TVD.** Identitas runs eTransit (electronic accompanying documents) with web services for accredited software vendors, and ATV-Viehhandel exists. Sources: https://www.bk.admin.ch/dam/bk/de/dokumente/dti/eservices/technische_servicebeschreibung_accompanyingdocument.pdf.download.pdf/technische_servicebeschreibung_accompanyingdocument.pdf, https://www.blv.admin.ch/blv/de/home/tiere/transport-und-handel/viehhandel.html

name: Household employers (domestic workers)
text: - **Household employers (domestic workers).** Quitt ("Cheque Emploi Service" covering registration, contracts and social insurance), the cantonal Chèque service and Fairboss already offer done-for-you service. Compensation offices offer simplified procedures. Sources: https://quitt.ch/en/, https://www.ahv-iv.ch/p/2.06.d, https://www.fairboss.ch/haushaltshilfe-anstellen/lohnempfehlungen

name: Money-changer compliance
text:
- **Money-changer compliance:**
  - Firms need a CBS licence and a USD 1.25M deposit (CNBC Arabia, March 2025), so these are not small operators.
  - The substitutes are core-banking and AML vendors plus lawyers.

name: Pesticide dealer register (農藥販賣業)
text: - **Pesticide dealer register (農藥販賣業).** This looked ideal: about 3,614 small shops, real-name sales since 2021, quarterly reports and fines of NT$15k–150k. It was killed because the regulator supplies the software. About 75% of retailers use a government-promoted POS that reports continuously, the free 農藥販賣管理資訊系統 is installed at 600+ dealers, and hardware was subsidised. Sources: https://www.moa.gov.tw/ws.php?id=2504874 , https://www.agriharvest.tw/archives/62390/ , https://www.moa.gov.tw/ws.php?id=2503151

name: Coastal fishing landing declarations
text: - **Coastal fishing landing declarations.** About 3,500 vessels; a free government app and web channel; fishers won't pay. Source: https://www.agriharvest.tw/archives/60336/

name: ADDO drug shops
text: - **ADDO drug shops:** a plausible quiet industry (paper dispensing registers, Pharmacy Council reforms, inspection possibly moving to TMDA), but it was not diligenced. Count and competitors (pharmacy POS) were not checked. A follow-up lead if more budget is available. (https://medicopress.media/pharmacy-council-overwhelmed-government-eyes-tmda-for-inspections/, https://thecitizen.co.tz/tanzania/news/national/one-year-pharmacy-graduates-in-tanzania-to-lose-recognition-from-december-5470852)

name: Pharmacy and other import licences
text: - **Pharmacy and other import licences.** Too few operators. SAMES and the customs single window already cover the flow.

name: Bureau-de-change KYC/BCT reporting (circular 2026-02)
text:
- **Bureau-de-change KYC/BCT reporting (circular 2026-02):** this had the best trigger of the pass: 380+ licensed counters, mandatory software, a monthly SED report and new 2026 KYC and goAML duties. It was killed by **Insight Plus "Hive+"**: a cloud bureau-de-change system with about 75% share (more than 180 bureaux in 23 governorates), whose "Bridge+" is the BCT's own reporting tool. Sources:
  - https://www.ilboursa.com/marches/la-startup-tunisienne-insight-plus-equipe-la-bct-de-sa-solution-de-reporting-reglementaire-bridge-_32148
  - https://www.lapresse.tn/2026/01/27/nouvelle-circulaire-bct-vigilance-maximale-pour-les-bureaux-de-change/
  - https://www.tustex.com/economie-actualites-economiques/circulaire-de-la-bct-de-nouvelles-regles-pour-les-bureaux-de-change-en-tunisie
  - https://www.webmanagercenter.com/2024/01/29/519833/les-bureaux-de-change-manuel-en-tunisie-une-activite-en-plein-essor/

name: Livestock identification
text: - **Livestock identification:** a state-run OEP system in place since 1998 (https://rr-africa.woah.org/app/uploads/2016/12/7-tunisie-identification.pdf). No paid layer and no new trigger.

name: Licensed-activity renewal tracker
text: - **Licensed-activity renewal tracker** for disinfection, seed, fuel, pharmacy and education licences. A real obligation exists (Law "On licensing of some activities", new edition), but the licensing ministries handle it at the counter. The market is small, and FX and internet barriers block a foreign vendor.

name: NDA drug shops and vet outlets
text:
- **NDA drug shops and vet outlets:** annual licensing run by NDA and DVOs. Enforcement is visible
  (closure campaigns) but annual only. Dispensing-register software was not researched.

name: Vet pharmacies and pet shops (2026 Rx rules)
text: - **Vet pharmacies and pet shops (2026 Rx rules).** ENOTE already serves clinics and pharmacies, with ПРРО integration.

name: Wales special procedures licensing
text: - **Wales special procedures licensing:** a 3-year licence; consent-record apps exist.

name: Household employers (nannies, caregivers)
text:
- **Household employers (nannies, caregivers).** Minnesota Paid Leave premiums began Apr 30 2026, but nanny payroll services already cover it:
  - Poppins $49/mo, HomePay $59, GTM $70, SurePayroll $39.
  - Sources: https://www.techrepublic.com/article/best-nanny-payroll-services/, https://www.foley.com/insights/publications/2025/11/minnesotas-new-paid-leave-law-is-here-what-employers-need-to-do-before-january-1-2026/

name: Bail agent monthly reports
text: - **Bail agent monthly reports.** Captira ($99/mo) and BailBooks ($55/mo). Sources: https://captira.com/pages/bail-software, https://ncdoi.gov/documents/bail-bond/electronic-monthly-filing-bail-bondsman-faqs/open

name: Outfitter use reports
text: - **Outfitter use reports.** LodgeRunner and Flybook. Source: https://lodgerunner.com/Fishing-Outfitter-Software.aspx

name: Seafood dealer trip tickets
text: - **Seafood dealer trip tickets.** Free VESL and SAFIS eDR. Source: https://coastalreview.org/2025/11/seafood-dealers-reminded-to-switch-software-by-year-end/

name: NERIS for volunteer fire departments
text: - **NERIS for volunteer fire departments.** Free federal app and RMS vendors. Source: https://www.lexipol.com/resources/blog/the-switch-from-nfirs-to-neris-is-here/

name: Driver-education completion uploads (TX, NY)
text: - **Driver-education completion uploads (TX, NY).** Watch only. School software can add the export, and each school deals with one state. Sources: https://www.tdlr.texas.gov/news/2025/05/05/coming-soon-in-2025-tdlr-rolls-out-new-system-for-driver-education-provider-certificate-completion-uploads/, https://www.iroquoiscsd.org/student-parent-resources/driver-education/driver-ed-certificates-of-completion

name: Pawnshop register software
text: - **Pawnshop register software.** Already served by LendMe, MISA eShop and Pawnmate [S]. It survives only inside the cross-trade ANTT kit (Opportunity 1).

name: Livestock activity declarations
text: - **Livestock activity declarations.** Covered by the free MAE/VNPT national database and app [S]. The buyers are smallholders.

name: Driving schools
text: - **Driving schools.** DAT and telematics hardware vendors serve them [B].

name: Peru fuel-station register (illegal-mining zones)
text: Downgraded 7.5->5.5 in development plan: station POS vendors already hold the data; Rayo Fact competes. See research/plans/ (Peru plan).

name: Philippines EIS e-invoicing kit
text: Downgraded 7.0->5.5: local billing-software vendors build EIS themselves; ESP accreditation frozen. See research/plans/.

name: Chile contractor accreditation pack
text: Downgraded 6.5->5.0: MINPASS, Mine Pass, MyPass and ACREDIX passport products compete. See research/plans/.

name: Argentina SIGIRAO bridge
text: Downgraded 6.5->5.5: ministry integration tools let dealer software connect natively. See research/plans/.

name: Brazil SIPROQUIM map generator
text: Downgraded 6.5->5.5: business software (e.g. TOTVS) already exports the file; free government validator. See research/plans/.

name: Egypt EPTTS file compiler
text: Downgraded 7.0->5.5: regulator direct-XML route lets suppliers report themselves. See research/plans/.

name: Kenya SHA claims/rejections desk
text: Downgraded 6.5->5.0: 28 DHA-certified HMIS platforms; government system covers ~87% of clinics. See research/plans/.

name: Florida FOG / grease-waste compliance router
text: Benchmark idea from research/brief.md. Quick check rated ~5/10: PumpDocket, ServiceCore, Tank Track, RapidWorks already generate manifests; possible gap is submission to many county/utility portals.

name: Weekly PJ police register for used-gold buyers
text: Opus review cut 4->2: Gouwin (Inforbarras) and Ponto25 Ourives already produce the PJ declarations. See research/offline/portugal.md.

name: Multi-farm PPP/fertiliser input journal
text: Opus review cut 4->3: missed eAgronom LT, Agro247, Geoface, FarmEasy. See research/offline/lithuania.md.
